183002.description:
I Can't Wait for the Protagonist to Show Up! The Supporting Character Brother Saves His Step-Sister Heroine!

Before I knew it, I had reincarnated as Kanzaki Eiji, a side character in the game 'Koikoi ni Somaru Sora'.

Eiji is the stepbrother of the game's heroine you are trying "capture". In other words, there's supposed to be another protagonist. So, I figured I should enjoy my second life without stirring up too much trouble.

But—my stepsister Suzuna, the heroine the protagonist is supposed to "capture", seems to be in a lot of pain. In the game, the protagonist saves Suzuna three years from now.

Should I just leave her alone until then...? No, that’s impossible! Even if I'm not the protagonist, as her brother, I will find a way to save Suzuna!

The struggle of a supporting character brother to save his heroine sister begins!

On the other hand, Chiaki Kurisu, a sales representative from a trading company, always seems very serious when she visits for business. For some reason, Kurisu suddenly invites Yokozawa to dinner!? Outside of work, Kurisu-san is completely different from her usual business-like behavior, being totally open and vulnerable...!?

“This woman, is cuter than me!?”

You can’t help but fall for her. ♡ Adult girls-love ♡

After his father passed and his sister declared she never wanted to see him again, Hyunseung died mysteriously only to find himself back in his teenage body—before he began his career and before his father died. This time, he'll use his skills to support the family he took for granted in his previous life and show them just how much he loves them.

But she never expected to add the eight-year-old duke, Caius Baltail, to her protection list--until the emperor arranged their marriage. Meanwhile, she’s also got an eye on her nemesis, rival knight Anthody Everett, is tracking down the truth about her parents’ death, struggling to get out of debt, and even gets stuck in a time-distorted dimension! The Moon family is in peril after the death of their father and eldest son. Moon Ji-dam turns to her fiancee Shin Woo-jo for help in a desperate attempt to solve the family’s woes.

‘How could she romp around so lasciviously every night when she has a fiancee?’

After hearing a groundless rumor, Woo-jo cruelly turns her away, never stopping to think that he may have been deceived.

‘I think I still have some pride remaining.’

With those words, Ji-dam parts ways with Woo-jo. Five years after the marriage was broken off, The pair meet again when Ji-dam is sent by the emperor to work as a petty officer at Woo-jo’s Guryang Fortress. Despite his cold demeanor towards her, Woo-jo can’t help but be bothered by her every move. After remaining still for some time, the wheels of fate begin to turn once again. What lies in store for the lingering feelings between them...?!

183026.description:
"Mei-chan, have you ever had sex with somebody?"

Riku, a second-year middle school student, came over to visit his childhood friend and past classmate Mei to ask for her advice on certain things. The details of his consultation with her were as follows: "I got asked by a girl in my class to take her virginity because her boyfriend couldn't handle blood." He says the girl's reason for asking him to do it was that, she thought he was just the right boy for it. He admitted that he didn't have the heart to turn her down on the spot, because he was also somewhat interested in those things.

In any case, Riku was bothered if he really was the right guy to take the girl's first time, so Mei tells him:
"For me... I wouldn't want to do it with somebody I don't love, never mind give him my first time. I don't get how people like her think..."

Riku also responds to Mei's opinion, and so he tells her what he feels...

A slightly naughty story featuring some of the innocence and embarrassment of a boy and girl going through adolescence.

(Source: BookLive, translated)

Note: Published in 2 versions, a fully censored version and an R-18 version with mosaics. Censorship level and cover differences aside, the story is the same.

183027.description:
I'm dating my childhood friend "Yuzu", and the two of us are playing games at my house like usual. But today, it looks like I have a mission: it's our 100th day since we started going out! So I pretended that I was having a stomachache, leaving Yuzu's side for a moment and dashed out of my room so I could prepare a surprise for her, when...

Huh?! Yuzu, who was left alone by herself, went hunting for hidden things in my room as payback, finding my erotic books; even worse, she also found the DVDs that came with them...

"Yu- Yuzu!! That... Where did you... ", I stammered as my mind went blank.
"Let's break up...", Yuzu cried while sulking.

"You don't even try to hold hands with me."
"I'll get hurt if you keep treating me like your childhood friend."
With our hearts pounding, we spill our true feelings and real intentions to each other, and then gathered the courage to do the things that we can't do if we were just childhood friends.

This is a story about an innocent and clumsy couple in the springtime of their lives.

(Source: BookLive, translated)

Note: Published in 2 versions, a fully censored version and an R-18 version with mosaics. Censorship differences aside, the story is the same.

Furthermore, it turns out that everyone else at the mixer already had a girl he's interested in, so Yutaro is told to take care of the remaining unclaimed woman. But that "remaining" college girl turns out to be Kiraboshi Ayane, the former leader of a wildly popular idol group!? Yutaro's life takes a dramatic turn when he gets together with Kiraboshi Ayane, the former idol who is cute enough to be called a "national treasure."

It's sick to think that this kind of thing is actually happening on a daily basis behind closed doors in our towns. How can they do this with impunity? Why doesn't anyone try to save them? The harsh reality of child abuse confronts Itsuko Mukonda, who became a child welfare officer because she was unable to save her friend, who was abused and starved to death by her parents when she was a girl... Sanjou Rokuro, a part-time worker was persuaded by his mischievous friend to impulsively download a dating app one night while drunk. To his surprise, he matched with Sanjou Yuuha, his stepsister. They began exchanging messages, each pretending to be someone else, and Rokuro soon learned that Yuuha, a high school student, had stopped attending classes.

Yuuha reached out for help, and Rokuro decided to take her in and have her live with him! However, Rokuro has a troubled past, too: just before graduating high school, his father had disowned him.

She feels humiliated instead of terrified after the ghost witnesses her boring sex life with her husband. The ghost begins appearing in their bedroom nightly.

(Source: Anime News Network)

183056.description:
"Our Season," a love reality show that gathers handsome and beautiful high school students from across the nation to experience a sweet and refreshing youth. It's an idyllic haven of first love, a paradise that every teenager dreams of.

— At least, that's what it appears to be on the surface.

In reality, it's a fabricated academy where youth is sacrificed for a shot at stardom in the entertainment industry.

Souji was supposed to live out a scripted, predictable teenage romance... or so he thought.

"I've decided— I want to find a real lover through this show," she declares.

Karen, who claims to have come to fulfill her first love. Ema, who is destined to be his girlfriend according to the script. And Asuka, with whom he maintains a secret relationship.

While they portray innocent youth on camera, behind the scenes, unhealthy relationships intertwine and spiral into a pit of desire. The most dangerous youth has just begun.

(Source: GA Bunko, translated)
synonyms: Try Me Until You Want a Real Girlfriend

183057.description:
"Kuro-chan," as Kanagi Kuroudo is known online, has a close friend named "Gori-san." Gori-san is a skilled female gamer who dominates both fighting games and FPS titles. A year older than Kuroudo and a high school senior herself, she's generally polite and kind. But when she faces off against Kuroudo in a game, she transforms—becoming relentless with her teasing and trash-talking.

Despite this, Kuroudo finds her competitive spirit and playful jabs endearing, and he happily banters back. He even confides in her about his crush on a senior at school—but little does he know what’s in store for him…

A romantic comedy where connections through the internet and games spark an unexpected love story begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, Translated)
synonyms: A Story About How The Online Game Friend Who Was Being Provoked Was A Beautiful Senior With Good Manners

183059.description:
Minamino Chinatsu is a beautiful girl who's incredibly popular and easygoing. Ever since I met her in the fall of my first year of high school, my life has been anything but ordinary. It all changed when another guy with the same name as me showed up at school – a handsome one, no less – and suddenly my classmates started calling me 'Number Two.'

"You're not 'Number Two' to me," she said. "Besides, it's me who wants to kiss you first."

My relationship with Chinatsu goes beyond just school. We play street basketball after class, cook meals together, share secrets, and even grow physically closer. I thought I was fine being alone, but she accepts me for who I am. And because of that, I want to give her the same in return.

This is a coming-of-age love story about realizing how precious even the simplest desires can be.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

183078.description:
The kingdom of Formont is located at the heart of the continent. Charlotte, the grandson of Joseph, the founding hero of the country, is the youngest princess of the kingdom and a book-loving recluse. She hardly ever shows herself and has failed many matchmaking attempts, but when her father, the king, orders her to go hunting with Albert Horseman, the feared “headless knight,” she is forced to take on a new challenge...?

A new kind of royal mystery between a reclusive princess and a fierce knight!

(Source: Hana to Yume, translated)

183079.description:
Kawai Yuuma had a childhood friend, Kuramoto Suzuka. She was a year younger than him, and also the little sister of his best friend, Akira. To Yuuma, she'd always been like a little sister, even as they were now in high school.

That's what he thought, anyway... until one day, Akira fell for a senior at his part-time job.

"That's insane," Suzuka scoffed, admitting she had no clue about romantic feelings.

Yuuma himself had some baggage when it came to love, but he was curious about "that kind of thing."

"I hear kissing feels good?"

He knew it was wrong, but he couldn't resist crossing the line. They made a deal: this messy situation would only last until they found someone they truly loved.

(Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated)
synonyms: Love, Romance, And All That Nonsense

183080.description:
"In a week, I will kill you." That's the message delivered alongside a cat-eared reaper who appears before those who have committed crimes.

Codename 33, who is also known as Mimi, is a unique kind of assassin who grants her targets a seven-day reprieve before taking their lives.

A young man caught up in drug trafficking, a pregnant woman with just one week left until her due date, a girl who killed someone for her father, and a boy who believes he's reforming society by killing evil—these are just some of the people Mimi is destined to kill. What do they wish for? How do they choose to live during those last seven days?

"Bon Voyage"

This story delves into life and death, exploring the relationship between a cat-eared reaper who delivers the final moments to criminals and those she's destined to kill.

(Source: GA Bunko, translated)
synonyms: In A Week, I Will Kill You

title.native: 一週間後、あなたを殺します

183081.description:
If you had one day left before disappearing from this world, what would you do?

There’s a rumor about a beautiful girl who can reunite you with someone who has passed away. As your life force fades, she appears before you, introducing herself as Ai, an angel. Her mission: to grant the final wishes of souls who have lost their physical bodies.

To carry out these wishes, Ai descends into the human world, accompanied by her gruff yet loyal partner, a demon named Dia.

"What is it that you still long for?" she asks, her voice gentle yet firm.

With her breathtaking beauty, Ai reaches out to the souls left alone in death. Her words stir up long-buried dreams and regrets: promises unfulfilled, the desire to see a loved one’s smile, to offer gratitude and apologies, to go on that longed-for date, to celebrate a dear one’s special day.

"I hope you can say goodbye with a smile to the person you love most," she whispers.

This is a story of encounters and farewells with Ai, a kindhearted but slightly melancholic angel, who dedicates herself to fulfilling your final wish.

(Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated)
synonyms: Farewell Flowers For "Ai", An Angel Looking For Love: One Thing I Want to Do Before My Time Runs Out

183082.description:
My summer vacation started with a kick in the backside, six years after I last saw her. I, Maori Ryuuto, had given up dancing for personal reasons, and now here she was: my childhood friend, back from America, all grown up into a beautiful girl.

"Come on! Aim for my butt, go ahead, kick it with all your might!"

How did things get like this? Apparently, Yuuzuki Arling Seiran, my childhood friend who had blossomed into a stunning beauty during her time abroad, was going to be living with me as part of a homestay program. Seriously?! "I want to see Ryuu-kun dance again," she said, her eyes sparkling with mischief.

This is a coming-of-age story about how I, who had given up on dancing, find the courage to reach for the stars again. Or maybe it's just the story of my days being filled with the antics of this annoyingly adorable childhood friend who keeps making me dance to her tune.

(Source: Overlap Bunko, translated)

183091.description:
Xu Yulian is the eldest daughter of a wealthy family, smart and beautiful. Her life should've been a smooth ride, until she ran into a stumbling block named "Xu Wenjiao." Her sister came out of nowhere and became the person she hates the most. When she was a child, the frail Xu Wenjiao occupied all of her mother's time and attention. After she grew up, Xu Yulian had a crush on the neighbor girl who had just returned from studying abroad. But before she could get up the courage, she saw the girl confess to Xu Wenjiao instead. In this house, it's going to be either her or Xu Wenjiao, one or the other. Xu Yulian got so angry that she actually packed her bags to leave home, but her sister, who always seemed so weak and frail, suddenly grabbed her by the wrist wrist and pushed her into the corner. Xu Wenjiao looked at her jealously and whispered in her ear: "Sister, why do you like her but not me?" Xu Yulian blushed, "Xu Wenjiao, are you crazy? Have you been reading too many bad romance novels to be acting this way?"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Add Mochi, Akari’s stuffed animal and imaginary friend who loves to ship people, into the mix, and things are sure to get even more complicated!

The story of a forbidden Edo love affair between a brothel hostess and prostitute, two people who can never be together.

183097.description:
Kodaira had a certain ability. It was the power to hear the inner thoughts of people around him. However, he has gotten quite tired of hearing the inner voices of the people around him, which got way too noisy after the growth of his ability.

On one such day, Ayane Hibino, the girl sitting next to him, was chatting with a female friend during break time, when the supposedly sleeping Kodaira began hearing her inner thoughts: "He's the type of guy who seems the most dangerous." and "I bet he doesn't have any friends." which were all badmouthing him. Hearing the things he didn't want to hear the most caused his stress to reach its limits, and he angrily screamed in his head "Enough! Shut up already!", which caused Ayane to be quiet.

At that moment, certain feelings he's never had before started rushing through his entire being. Kodaira, who has obtained the power to transmit his thoughts to his target, used his newfound power to make Ayane do things like: take her classes without wearing a bra under her uniform, expose her panties for others to see, and ultimately get manipulated by him in whatever way he wished.

Finally, Kodaira moves on to the next step of his plan after school that day. Inside an empty classroom, he and Ayane will...

When Suzune finds out that Arata is going to live and work at a kappo restaurant, she can't stop her heart from pounding.

183191.description: American multimillionaire Meryl has just one problem: until she turns twenty-seven or gets married, she can’t use her father’s inheritance freely. Determined to get the money her friend needs, Meryl puts a wanted ad for a husband in the paper.

183192.description:
I'm a childhood friend of mine, a busty high school girl, and we're a super lovey-dovey couple♪ But at first, I couldn't get a good sense of distance between us, until I met "that"... Eh? What's that? -- It's "cuckold threesome sex" with Ryo, who is also a childhood friend!!! Thanks to Ryo, our relationship was going well, but one day, Ryo got a girlfriend. I have no choice but to do "that" with a guy from a secret account... And so, Nakanishi, a macho man with a big dick and a skilled technician, came to see us! Nakanishi has overwhelming virility, and I feel it many times more than usual... My pride as a man is shattered, but... we're okay now! ...Right?

183193.description:
When Luce, an art dealer, first arrives in Venice for work, she sees a man standing on a wharf and gets a powerful wave of déjà vu.

Trying to ignore the powerful feeling, she goes sightseeing around the city. And then she runs into the man from the wharf! He introduces himself as Michele, and when Luce states that it’s her first time in Venice, his expression fills with rage. Her day keeps getting stranger, but she manages to make it to her employer’s home—only to learn that her new employer…is Michele!

(Source: Harlequin Comics)

183194.description:
Lizzie’s great-aunt was once a famous actress, and she had a deep connection with the Kingdom of Voltavia and its former king. Lizzie, a historian, decides that she wants to gather all of her great-aunt’s stories about the king into a book. She pushes the present king, Daniel, for an interview but is rebuffed.

(Source; Harlequin comics)

183195.description:
Saskia agreed to seduce her best friend’s lover in order to find out whether he was cheating. So wearing a sexy dress and makeup, she approached the man who was allegedly her friend’s boyfriend, but it turned out to be the wrong man! What’s more, he was Andreas, the new CEO of the hotel Saskia works at!!

(Source: Harlequin Comics)

183196.description:
Laura is a reporter whose drive to help those in need keeps causing her to miss her scoops. With her job on the line, she goes after a big story, looking for a scandal about Xander, the crown prince of Montorino!

(Source: Harlequin Comics)

183197.description:
"This man is my boss…and my father’s enemy.” Bryce’s dirty tricks drove Paige’s father to his death. Now she slips into Bryce’s company as a secretary in order to find out his weakness. However, he doesn’t trust her and is trying to discover her motives. They’ve both been keeping their suspicions a secret, but now the seeds of a dangerous love are beginning to sprout!

(Source: Harlequin Comics)

183198.description:
In an age of myths and legends, the story of Flavia—Envoy of the Goddess—stands above the rest. A 999-year-old virginal saint, Flavia is humanity's protector, mother, judge, and a name children learn before they even know the name of their own parents. As her first millennium on earth is closing in, she wishes to lose her virginity to a strong male, but the kingdom is full of weaklings who put her on a pedestal. She needs a burly male who'll treat her like a piece of meat and pound her into submission, and as fate would have it, the man of her dreams is about to meet her judgment.

(Source: Fakku!)

183216.description:
Life is Adventure, a full-dive RPG, has transformed into a deadly game for 100,000 players after its developers went rogue. Game over means death in real life!

Yamamoto Rinka, a beautiful gamer girl in her late twenties, curses her fate... but not really?

"Forced long vacation! Might as well enjoy clearing it without rushing!"

Amidst all this, Yamamoto has acquired a mysterious unique skill called Balance.

[Acquired Fire Magic Lv5]
Balance activated.
Balances all attributes, acquiring mastery of every magic type.
[Acquired Water Magic Lv5, Wind Magic Lv5, Earth Magic Lv5, Light Magic Lv5, Dark Magic Lv5]

Due to this cheat-like skill arbitrarily boosting her stats and wealth without her consent, Yamamoto becomes a monstrous player from the very beginning!

…Is this even a legitimate death game? Well, whatever, might as well have fun with it!

This is the story of Yamamoto, who thrives in this deadly game world while unknowingly dominating everything around her!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Yamamoto-san Breaking Balance of Death Game

183217.description:
Kunieda Shunki was enjoying a smooth start to his high school life, despite dealing with his yandere-ish childhood friend, Miki Sayaka. However, one day, he gets teased about his relationship with Sayaka by his classmate Chisaki Yuki, who even goes so far as to try to kiss him. To make matters worse, Sayaka witnesses this whole scene and becomes enraged.

The next morning, Shunki tries to clear up the misunderstanding but finds that Sayaka has somehow split into two! Now he’s caught between two jealous versions of Sayaka. Adding to the chaos, Shunki learns that Yuki’s gender has changed to male, leaving him utterly bewildered!

As Shunki investigates this strange phenomenon, he discovers a connection to the legend of the "Everlasting Higanbana" at the temple where Yuki lives. He becomes captivated by the mysterious power of these flowers and finds himself entangled in a new-age love story with supernatural elements, centered around teenage boys and girls!

(Source: Kodansha Lanove Bunko, translated)
synonyms: Fifteen Springs and the Bloom of Sixteen Nights: Two Loves That Long to Be Bound But Cannot

183220.description:
Lovely Sorcerer, a high-difficulty romance action RPG where mastering heroine conquest is a challenge, follows a man who loved this game so much that he ran a strategy guide website in real life. He’s reincarnated into the world of the game as an obscure mob noble whose name wasn’t even mentioned in the main story...

“Hermes? I don’t remember this character... but wait, this guy has All-Attribute Proficiency!”

He gains the dream ability (stats) to become the strongest! Fueled by his gamer blood, he thinks:

“Since I’m a mob character, going all out to reach ultimate strength will definitely be fun!!”

But instead of building the strongest character freely, he unexpectedly becomes the center of attention at the academy! Even the heroines who were supposed to end up with the main protagonist start flocking to him?!

Thus begins the journey to create the ultimate gamer-crafted overpowered character!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

"Even if I die... I'll take you with me!"

"The world has ended now, so how about I try keeping human pets?"

I don't know why, but the world has come to an end. People don't hesitate to murder their friends and family as survival and desire are the only values that rule over them. All the survivors of this new world were given a single skill of their choice. Seong-Cheol, suffering from insomnia, chose the skill "sleep." He is appointed captain of the elite Dragon Killer Squad, which consists of the elegant female knight Loe, the cool female knight Katia, and the easygoing teacher Flamebelle. However, both Loe and Katia refuse to acknowledge Zeke as their leader and challenge him! Surrounded by beautiful women older than himself, Zeke's harem life begins, with a sweet yet strong-willed heart that knows when to be decisive!

Jiho has a superpower that causes explosions whenever she gets excited, making dating and fun nearly impossible—until she discovers that touching her new neighbor, Yechan, miraculously helps her control her ability. Determined to maintain physical contact without outright harassing him, Jiho embarks on a mission to “seduce” Yechan and become his girlfriend. Along the way, ghostly advice and a whirlwind of chaos lead her to uncover the mystery of their unique connection in this unpredictable romance.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

183233.description:
"The beginning of every incident begins with stumbling upon a small trace left behind by someone. However, most small traces are fragments of something that is already broken."

An ordinary repeat student, Jeong Si-Myeong. Strange incidents continue to occur around him, and as he digs into the truth, his memories become tangled and seem to be shrouded in fog. And all of these incidents point back to him...

"If you didn't do it, then who did all this..?"

(Source: Naver, translated)

183234.description:
An island town covered in spiders. Can she escape the web of suspicion?

(Source: Naver, translated)

College student Kikumaru is wooed by an older man, Kuniyuki, and falls in love with him, but he is rejected. Unable to give up, Kikumaru joins the host club that Kuniyuki owns, but... Dopeness Love, released in two volumes at the same time!

Jin Hyoseop is an S-class guide whose powers leave him aroused and smelling as sweet as honey. In order to hide his embarrassing secret, he joins a C-class guild on the condition that he only does the minimum guiding required to heal his esper guildmates. It shouldn’t be an issue since the guild’s kind and understanding commander Andante assures him that they don’t handle any dangerous jobs. But then, why does everyone keep coming back injured and in desperate need of guiding? Little does Hyoseop know that he has just stepped into a lair of criminal S-class espers!

183237.description:
Yokoya, a serious new teacher, and Seo, the laid-back school doctor, are bitter rivals. Yokoya can't stand Seo's inappropriate work attitude and how, despite it, Seo remains popular with the students. "I care about the students way more than he ever does!" Yokoya often tells himself. However, one evening, overwhelmed by the daily stress, Yokoya collapses while working overtime. To his surprise, it's Seo who comes to his rescue, providing first aid. Grateful, Yokoya thanks Seo for unexpectedly taking care of him. But before he knows it, Seo is carrying him... to a love hotel!

The lure of monetary benefits makes Jessica Yan's adoptive family force her into an engagement with a rich young man. She is scheduled to meet her fiance at a hotel, but sheer coincidence leads her into the room where her fiance's uncle is staying. Her encounter with that renowned and powerful man is merely the beginning of a complex web of interactions…

(Source: WebComics)

183239.description:
From good looks, brains, hot body, wealth, and a gorgeous family. It seemed like Ju-Min’s life was god perfect. Until he realized that his world was merely a simulation controlled by… well, a teenage girl! With just a click of her mouse, Ju-Min loses everything and returns to high school! Will he break free from the program and reclaim what he lost?

(Source: WEBTOON)

183240.description:
After a life of family abuse and betrayal, Lumina Lanchoux, a supernatural Leggion being, is saved from the brink of death by her half-brother Endymion. Just then, her healing powers awaken, and she is discovered by Duke Hart, the most powerful living Leggion. He sends her back in time to age 12 with the mission of saving his son Karajan from death by his own superpowers. Under the care of House Hart, Lumina is set for a peaceful second life. That is until she learns of the duke's deadly secret.

(Source: Tapas)

183241.description:
The daughter of a wealthy merchant, Sai Reiran, was chosen to become the Emperor's newest consort. however, on the trip to the Imperial Capital, she runs away with the son of another merchant! In order to fulfill the emperor's orders, and keep their heads, the family orders Reiran's cousin, Shuran, to take her place instead! They tell her to just pretend to be Reiran, while they search for the real one, however that's easier said than done! Shuran struggles to keep her real identity a secret and ends up being caught up in all sorts of trouble! Not to mention the intrigues and plots that go on daily in the inner palace... How will Shuran survive...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Ronaldine is an ambitious woman. When she finds herself as an orphan in a novel she once read, she decides to use her knowledge from the real world to become the best secretary anyone could ever have. Little did she know that her skills would take her all the way to the royal palace--where she becomes the tyrant emperor's personal secretary. Ronaldine fears for her life and wishes to quit her job, but it seems that she is the only person who can calm down the emperor from going on a murderous rampage.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

"I haven't had enough."

A big finance tycoon penetrates her deeply again and again, making her come sweetly... with every thrust, her love grows stronger. Even though she can't let him realize how she feels, no matter what... In order to recover her one million inheritance from her mother that an unscrupulous yakuza group has stolen from her, Aoi infiltrated a hostess club. What awaited her when she thought she had successfully gained his trust was a forced purchase of her freedom. That's when Reio Tatsugami, Aoi's regular client and the director of Zeus Finance, shows up before her. Shockingly, he declares he will buy her from the yakuza for two million. He makes a proposal to her.

"Have sex with me for 5,000 a month to pay back your debt."

Read about the unrequited love on both sides with an ideal man who's a finance tycoon!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

183245.description:
Alicia Sorcelion is a Noble Lady of the Empire, whose only sin was believing in love. When a doctored prophecy matches her likeness, Prelate Libenthius, a religious leader of the Empire's Central Pantheon, conspires to take advantage of Alicia, puppeting her as the "Saintess" of the empire and betrothing her to the Crown Prince, Viktor Lawrence.

While she is praised by the masses,she conceals her apparent lack of divine power, and lives a secluded and lonely life, only finding solace in her love for Viktor, who she believes to reciprocate her feelings. After ViKtor becomes Emperor, he reveals that he too was using her as a pawn in his ambitious plans, and with the appearance of a new "True Saintess" appears, Alicia is branded as a traitor and "False Saintess" in the eyes of the public, eventually sentenced to burn at the stake as a witch and traitor of the Empire.

Given another chance at life from the heavens, she opens her eyes in the past, with evidence of living a tragic future branded on her. Determined to avoid the prophecy at all costs, she aims to become a religious servant of the Empire, immune to the prophecy and the influence of her traitors. However her journey is not so easy, as her fate is tangled with a helping Cleric, Edwin, and her past tormentors continue to enact their conspiracy from her past future.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: Un amour sous les voiles du mensonge

title.english: The Fake Saintess bears Tainted Robes
title.native: 元聖女は復讐を誓います

183246.description:
In this world, there are people called “magicians." They have the power to create supernatural phenomena with their innate talent called “magic." Magic is used in all fields, including medicine, science, and war. Magic is supposed to be nothing more than a tool. But there is a magician who breaks all the rules…

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

183247.description:
A chuunibyou girl who once called her herself the "Nightmare Disaster" — also known as Mea.

She was once Kurusu Reiou's troublemaking friend. They spent precious time together, taking pictures of her, uploading them to social media and making them go viral, even though Rei didn't even know her real name. This continued until Mea was scouted by an agency and left their hometown.

Eventually, Mea made her entertainment industry debut as a chuunibyou idol. However, after Reiou entered high school, he discovered that the class president, Juunaya Nagi, was none other than Mea, who had graduated from her chuunibyou phase. For some reason, she desperately wanted to become the student council president as a first-year student. But the current Nagi had become a socially awkward, introverted girl.

However, things take a turn when Furutori, an arrogant and skilled dominator, approaches him. Furutori quickly sees through Tenchi’s facade and exposes his hidden masochistic tendencies, pushing him to his limits. Though Tenchi tries to leave, the night spirals into an unexpected threesome. Blindfolded and bound, Tenchi experiences a rush of excitement. When he realizes it’s Furutori leading the way, dominating him in ways he’s never experienced, he feels pleasure unlike anything before.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183316.description:
Sara is one of four daughters of the Balks dukedom. Born with golden hair and eyes which are said to be those of a witch, she's a blemish on the family name.

Sara has endured all the mistreatment from her family in hopes of living freely once she becomes of age. However, when one of her sisters is to be wed, she is cast out into the land of the beastfolk, for fear she'll bring a curse upon the family. In a land where no humans are said to be able to survive, the cruel emperor of the beastfolk empire, Cael appears before her. Their eyes meet, and their fates are forever interwined... could this be fate?!

The curtain rises on this fantastical romance between the discarded lady and the wolf emperor who doesn't believe in fate!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Cruel Wolf Emperor's Contract Bride: A Noblewoman Cast Aside and Told "You're Not Family" Finds Love and Happiness in the Land of Beastfolk
title.native: 冷酷な狼皇帝の契約花嫁～「お前は家族じゃない」と捨てられた令嬢が、獣人国で愛されて幸せになるまで～
title.romaji: Reikoku na Ookami Koutei no Keiyaku Hanayome: "Omae wa Kazoku ja Nai" to Suterareta Reijou ga, Juujingoku de Aisarete Shiawase ni Naru made

183317.description:
Tanaka Yuya, a first-year high school student, has always struggled to get along with his older brother, Hayato, who constantly surrounds himself with friends and girlfriends that Yuya can’t relate to. Whenever they come over, Yuya retreats to his room, avoiding interaction. One day, while overhearing a conversation through the thin walls, Yuya is struck by “Kakimoto-san’s” view on love, who says, “I don’t need a girlfriend, I just want to be with someone I truly like.”

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Notes:
- Originally self-published on Pixiv, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.
- Includes five extra chapters.

183318.description:
Asahi Hikari, the most popular girl at school, is a radiant beauty with a light attribute and a sunny disposition. Not only is she a talented tennis player, but she also excels as a model. It’s as if she’s been blessed with every gift life has to offer.

On the other hand, her classmate Kageyama Reiya is a dark-attribute gaming otaku who prefers to stay in the shadows.

These two polar opposites should never cross paths, but after discovering their shared love for games on a chance bus ride, Hikari starts visiting Reiya's room every weekend. They spend time playing games side by side, and as they do, the distance between their hearts begins to close.

“See you tomorrow at our usual time!” she says with a smile.

This is the story of how a light-attribute girl and a dark-attribute boy find themselves in a rainbow-colored love.

(Source: GA Bunko, translated)
synonyms: 關於光屬性美少女朝日同學為何每週末都泡在我房間這件事

title.native: 光属性美少女の朝日さんがなぜか毎週末俺の部屋に入り浸るようになった件
title.romaji: Hikari Zokusei Bishoujo no Asahi-san ga Naze ka Mai Shuumatsu Ore no Heya ni Iribitaru You ni Natta Ken

183319.description:
After his first summer break in college, Taichi installs a dating app out of frustration at not having a girlfriend. To his surprise, he matches with a woman he once saw crying at his summer beach job...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

183320.description:
After being summoned to another world, Higure is excited at the thought of becoming a hero. However, he is met with the unexpected declaration, "No, you are our food."

Possessing infinite magical power, he is a legendary being capable of transforming the strong feelings of others into unique magic—known as the Endless Box (Elysion). It seems that Higure is that legend and holds the key to saving the oppressed beautiful girls with their own reasons for being in distress. What are the intentions of these girls who are trying to get him to kiss them for victory?!

“Higure-san, you can eat me too!”
“Do you dislike small breasts?”
“Hey, I’ll make you happy. Why don’t you become my little brother?”

Feasting on the intense kisses and wishes of these beauties, Higure sets out on his journey to become a hero!
synonyms: The Strongest in Another World with Boundless Magic: The Beautiful Girls with Their Own Circumstances Need Me

title.native: ありあまる魔力で異世界最強　ワケあり美少女たちは俺がいないとダメらしい
title.romaji: Ariamaru Maryoku de Isekai Saikyou: Wakeari Bishoujo-tachi wa Ore ga Inai to Damerashii

183321.description:
A new trend has emerged among the noblewomen, in which they reject their long-time engagement partners chosen for them by their parents. To counter this threat to her kingdom, the brave Queen Phillis finds herself needing to get married?! A beginner to romance, she gives an order to her childhood friend among the royal knights:

"I want to learn about true love, so teach it to me on hand and foot!"

Thus begins an adorable romantic comedy between a dense queen called the goddess of destruction and a knight who has hidden his feelings for many years.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.english: Teach Me True Love on Hand and Foot
title.native: 真実の愛を手とり足とり教えなさい
title.romaji: Shinjitsu no Ai wo Tetori Ashitori Oshienasai

183322.description:
I'll teach you what truly pleasurable sex feels like. With his warm, gentle caress, she finds her whole body more sensitive than it has ever been before... Sakuno Tokitsu's job as chief of the PR department is going great, and all her colleagues love her. Her actual love-life isn't faring so well, though? Sakuno worries that she's bad in bed and is scared to put herself out there. One evening, a highly skilled designer on her team, Nao Fujikawa, discovers her secret! Sakuno thinks Nao will laugh at her, but he earnestly listens to her worries... and offers to practice sex with her! He whispers in her ear, "I wanna make you feel good," so much more forward than usual, and at his touch, a sweet throbbing sensation wells up inside Sakuno... "Why does it feel so good just from his fingers?" So begin the pleasurable and affectionate lessons between a wolf in sheep's clothing and a woman who's a dead fish in bed☆

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Wanna Try having Passionate Sex with Me? - A Wolf in Sheep's Clothing -
title.native: 俺と本気セックス、試してみます？～豹変男子の甘い手ほどき～
title.romaji: Ore to Honki Sex, Tameshitemimasu? Hyouhen Danshi no Amai Tehodoki

183323.description:
Ushizawa convinces his now very recent ex-girlfriend, Kise, to try swinging, hoping that it will help put an end to their fights and bring them back together. While everything seems to have gone well at first, Kise realizes what she really wants from the experience… .

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comic Market 103

title.native: 彼女交換～こんなことになる筈じゃなかった～
title.romaji: Kanojo Koukan: Konna Kotoni Naru Hazu Janakatta

183324.description:
The commander of the Federal Empire, Ying Yu, is a cold, domineering, and difficult man. This is the impression that Gu Weilan has always had of her boss. Until after an interstellar battle, as the ship's doctor Gu Weilan treated his wounds, and she encountered Ying Yu's vulnerable form... In his vulnerable form, Commander Ying shows the characteristics of an incubus, and his temperament changes drastically, becoming like a clingy puppy in desperate need of comfort and companionship. What's going on with this sudden change?! I can't stand it!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: The Officer Is Madly in Love With Me
The Cold Commander by Day Cries in My Arms at Night
Baitian Lengbingbing De Zhihui Guan Wanshang Zai Wo Huai Li Ku Jiji
白天冷冰冰的指挥官晚上在我怀里哭唧唧
Commander Colum Was Crying In My Arms

title.english: Captain Levi is Cold As Ice
title.native: 高冷指挥官在我怀里哭唧唧
title.romaji: Gao Leng Zhihui Guan Zai Wo Huai Li Ku Jiji

183325.description:
Kaede is an exemplary student and a member of the archery club. She has a secret, though: she is a futanari. On top of that, she occasionally gets so horny that she needs to fap several times a day to calm down.

This is all good and well, until Mai, a female underclassman with a particularly sadistic streak, catches her red-handed. Now she’s at Mai’s mercy and Mai is hell bent on exploiting this opportunity and having her fun with Kaede’s dick and holes.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Released at Futaket 12.5

title.english: My Senior Is My New Toy

183326.description:
I'm cool, right? I'm popular? So she's surely going to fall in love with me right away…?
Hey, why's she acting like she doesn't like me at all!?!?
A narcissistic boy falls in love at first sight with an older girl!

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

183327.description:
"No way...?"

After witnessing his first girlfriend, Ria, cheating on him, Shinsei sent her a breakup message, ending it all. Invited to a mixer to take his mind off things, he discovered it was completely rigged. Feeling uncomfortable, he quietly left, only to be followed by Futaba Reina, the school's most beautiful girl, who suddenly kissed him—

"I came to this mixer because of you," she said.

And then he was taken back to her house!? She takes the lead, but when they're alone, she becomes awkwardly clingy...

"Do it with me. No, that's... wrong. Please do it with me."

A slightly adult pure love romantic comedy about starting over with a devoted girlfriend!
synonyms: After Dumping My Girlfriend Who Cheated on Me, I Got Taken Home by the Most Beautiful Girl in School

title.native: 浮気していた彼女を振った後、学園一の美少女にお持ち帰りされました
title.romaji: Uwaki Shiteita Kanojo wo Futta Ato, Gakuen Ichi no Bishoujo ni Omochikaeri Saremashita

183329.description:
My dating history is as long as my age...zero. Then, an app appeared on my phone—a hypnosis app capable of controlling anyone.

Testing proved the app's power was real. With this, a harem life wasn't just a dream! Go for it, me! Now's the time to abandon my conscience...wait.

"Why does every girl I've targeted have a problem?!"

A beautiful gal, a hidden beauty with a quiet personality, a cool and rich junior—the secrets they couldn't tell anyone are revealed thanks to the power of the hypnosis app!

I just wanted to be able to do naughty things...!

A self-proclaimed trashy guy, but ultimately good-hearted, finds himself running around helping people?! A hypnosis harem love comedy for all ages!
synonyms: I Want a Dream Harem Life with My Hypnosis App
Te ni Ireta Saimin Appli de Yume no Harem Seikatsu wo Okuritai

title.native: 手に入れた催眠アプリで夢のハーレム生活を送りたい
title.romaji: Te ni Ireta Saimin Apuri de Yume no Harem Seikatsu wo Okuritai

183330.description:
All of the students from Midorishino High's class 2-C are killed in a bus accident during a school trip. However, they are reincarnated as monsters in another world. Will the 24 reincarnated "bodies" of classmates be able to survive in a world ruled by a select few influential people with powers known as "gifts"?

(Source: Web Comic Gamma, translated)
synonyms: New World Builders: Survive With Class 24 "Body"

title.native: 新世界ビルダーズ～クラス24「体」で生き残れ～
title.romaji: Shin Sekai Builders: Class 24 "Karada" de Ikinokore

183331.description:
I met a girl by chance at the supermarket who looked like one of those landmine girls, but was actually homey on my way home from my part-time job.

Note: Previously also posted on Twitter with the title: Baito Kaeri no Super de Mitame Jirai-kei de Kateiteki no Onna no Ko ni Guuzen Deau Hanashi (バイト帰りのスーパーで見た目地雷系で家庭的な女の子に偶然出会う話)
synonyms: A Helpful High School Girl Who Looks Like a Landmine Girl
バイト帰りのスーパーで見た目地雷系で家庭的な女の子に偶然出会う話
Baito Kaeri no Super de Mitame Jirai-kei de Kateiteki no Onna no Ko ni Guuzen Deau Hanashi

title.native: 見た目は地雷系の世話焼き女子高生
title.romaji: Mitame wa Jirai-kei no Sewayaki Joshikousei

183332.description: Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 24 episodes and 8 chapters respectively.

title.native: 強引にされるのがスキなんですよね…?～夫よりスゴい不倫ピストンでイッちゃう女上司!～
title.romaji: Gouin ni Sareru no ga Suki nan desu yo ne...? Otto Yori Sugoi Furin Piston de Icchau Onna Joushi!

title.native: 浮気公認マユミさん 性欲、強すぎるから他の男とセックスして！！
title.romaji: Uwaki Kounin Mayumi-san Seiyoku, Tsuyosugiru kara Hoka no Otoko to Sex Shite!!

183334.description:
"Shokuyou" are phantom creatures whose bodily fluids turn into sweet nectar that humans can consume. Although believed to be extinct in modern times, they have been living secretly among humans. Haru, who looks exactly like a human, is one of them. When his classmate Shigure recognizes him as a shokuyou, he is “eaten” by Shigure, partly by force. However, he soon realizes that Shigure is not just playing with him, and what should have felt wrong is starting to feel good. Can a shokuyou and a human, caught in the complex relationship between food and predator, navigate a normal love life? As Haru grapples with these unanswerable questions, a group of mysterious transfer students claiming to be "Shokuyo" themselves appears...?

(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183335.description:
Kanato has lost both his brother and his childhood friend, Yuusei. Determined to change the fate of Yuusei, who was tragically murdered, Kanato embarks on a desperate journey to rewrite destiny.

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 明日の君に、言いたい事がある。
title.romaji: Ashita no Kimi ni, Iitai Koto ga Aru.

title.native: はるかなるレムリアより
深煙に巻かれる-人妻催眠寝取られ-
title.romaji: Shinen ni Makareru: Hitozuma Saimin Netorare

183339.description:
Introverted high schooler Xuting is used to being the target of bullies, but her life takes a dramatic turn when a new, mysteriously handsome repairman intervenes. Captivated by his quiet strength and grateful for his protection, Xuting feels an undeniable pull towards him. Yet, her world shatters when she stumbles upon his terrifying secret: he's a werewolf. Now, caught between burgeoning feelings and monstrous danger, Xuting must navigate a terrifying new reality where her protector might just be her greatest threat.

(Source: WebComics)

183340.description:
Xuanzhuang, who eventually became known as Sanzang Hoshi, is famed for journeying west to India to bring the Buddhist sutras to China. At first, however, he was only an interpreter and escort for his brother Changjie, until…? A grand historical fantasy set on the Silk Road in the 7th century!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

183341.description:
This is my love story with a landmine girl who's convinced that I'm her childhood friend.

(Source: Pixiv, translated)
synonyms: A Love Story About a Childhood Friend Who Looks Like a Landmine Girl
My Childhood Friend Who Looks Like a Landmine Type
Mitame Jirai-kei Osananajimi no Renai Story
見た目地雷系幼馴染の恋愛ストーリー

183342.description:
Short, but unforgettable, mysteries that that don't seem like anything special, but somehow fit into the niches of your everyday life!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Included Stories:
1. Mado wo Koete... (窓をこえて・・・)
2. Nettaigyo (熱帯魚)
3. Kaki Kueba... (柿くえば・・)
4. Fuyu no Hajimari (冬の始まり)
5. Mukashi no Kao (昔の顔)
6. Hataki (ハタキ)
7. Kinen Shashin (記念写真)
8. Recycle (リサイクル)
9. Nihon no Natsu (日本の夏)
10. Toubousha (逃亡者)
11. Delmo to Christmas (デルモとクリスマス)
12. Mayonaka no Ramen (真夜中のラーメン)

183343.description: Bella is cursed with a poison that takes the lives of anyone she touches. The way to break the curse is to be given "true love." She was rumored to be a "poisonous witch" and lived alone in the forest, but one day she met Anna, a painter who couldn't sell her art...

183344.description:
Takara, a popular actor, has a special condition that attracts both humans and non-humans. He initially leverages this ability to thrive in the entertainment industry, but after being expelled due to a fake scandal, he finds himself at a loss. Just when he thinks all hope is gone, Kokutan, a beautiful nine-tailed fox, appears before him. Kokutan suggests that Takara works in a brothel for non-humans...?

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183345.description:
What is this lovers' quarrel unfolding before my eyes?

Nagane Tomoya is a new employee in the general affairs department of a trading company. He takes pride in his seemingly inconspicuous job, supporting all the employees behind the scenes. One day, disaster strikes when he accidentally breaks his important pair of glasses. Surprisingly, he finds he can still see perfectly well—but what he sees isn't quite real..?

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: メガネをかけるとBLが視えちゃうメガネくんの困惑する日常
title.romaji: Megane wo Kakeru to BL ga Miechau Megane-kun no Konwakusuru Nichijou

183346.description:
It was then that the mermaid discovered his first love...

Merol is a beautiful mermaid prince known for his enchanting singing voice. His best friend is Krato, a flapjack octopus who is unfairly labeled as a “devil” by the sea residents.

One day, Merol rescues Will, a human prince cast out to sea, leading to a fateful encounter that changes everything. Despite Krato's warnings about the dangers of befriending humans, Merol’s heart refuses to listen, and he finds himself falling deeply in love with Will..?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)
synonyms: Der Meermann, der Prinz und der lügende Dämon

title.native: 人魚と王子とウソツキ悪魔
title.romaji: Ningyo to Ouji to Usotsuki Akuma

183347.description:
"We can't show this to our guests, can we?"

Mashiro is the number one host at Blanc. But then Blanc and Noir, the sister company, merge, causing Mashiro to lose his spot to Noir's number one, Reiya. He's good at pulling in the money, but he's got a nasty and arrogant attitude. This really put a bad taste in Mashiro's mouth, since he's working hard to pay off his family's debt. However, one day Mashiro makes the decision to break the rules and sleep with a customer. But before he can go through with it, Reiya catches him outside the hotel. Mashiro prepares to get fired, but Reiya gives him a wad of cash and tells him, "If you're going to sell your body, sell it to me."

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: シークレットアフター

183348.description:
In a world inhabited by “Forks” and “Cakes,” the predators known as Forks lack a sense of taste—except for one thing: the flesh of their prey, the Cakes. Kaname, a college student, leads a monotonous life, carefully hiding the fact that he is a Fork. His routine takes an unexpected turn when he meets Ishii, a Cake known for being the worst kind of drunk, who kisses Kaname upon their first encounter. Despite the awkward introduction, that kiss leaves an unforgettable sweetness lingering in Kaname’s mind...

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: フォークの先は甘い罠
title.romaji: Fork no Saki wa Amai Wana

183349.description:
Haru brought back a sex toy from the pink castle. But what will he do when he finds out that it's not working...?

(Source: Placebo Comics, translated)

title.native: やましい恋のはじめかた Sweetest lollipop
title.romaji: Yamashii Koi no Hajimekata: Sweetest lollipop

183350.description:
"Don't underestimate a former top host."

An ex-host tries to seduce inexperienced and shy CEO! Even though he is just the CEO of a printing company, Hirotaka helped Minami get out of the host business with exceptional offers. Minami never understood why Hirotaka did so much for him, but he eventually realizes that Hirotaka is actually in love with him. Just a slight touch or a suggestive whisper makes Hirotaka shy and clearly nervous. In spite of that, he runs away when Minami tries to make a move on him... There's no way he can be satisfied with just looking at him when they both have feelings for each other. He wants to try having sex with him. He wants to make love to him and make a mess out of him. Minami forcefully grabs him, pushes him down, and gives him a passionate kiss...!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ニコチンとキスとセックスと
title.romaji: Nicotine to Kiss to Sex to

183351.description: Electronically distributed versions of the applicant service mini booklet of Sahara no Kurowashi” and “Sahara no Kuriwasho 2 side Alkil", with additional corrections and updates.

title.native: サハラの黒鷲 こぼれた寝物語
title.romaji: Sahara no Kuro Washi: Koboreta Nemonogatari

183352.description:
My name is Sua Jo, and my life couldn't get any better - my loving dad is a Mayor, my handsome boyfriend is the top dog in school, my fun-to-be-with friends love me, and my background is top-notch. My life is perfect. But wait, did I just hit someone?! No, no I didn't... No one saw me, so nothing happened. My life is still perfect, or so I thought... until "M" appeared claiming to be a witness. You think I'll let you ruin my perfect life?! Just wait until I find you!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: パーフェクトライフのはずだったのに

183353.description:
Hayama is a skittish and struggling young artist specializing in bijin-ga, a genre focused on painting beautiful women. After fleeing from yet another model, he finds a beautiful figure collapsed by the roadside and takes them in —only to discover that they’re actually a boy in women’s clothes! But this time, Kenzan doesn’t feel the urge to run. Instead, he may have just found the perfect subject for his work!

(Source:Yen Press)

title.english: I Want You to Expose Me
title.native: どうか君に暴かれたい

183354.description:
Yumeki meets Hotaru, a fellow freshman, at university, and they quickly become best friends, sharing classes and experiences. While Hotaru graduates and secures a job, Yumeki finds himself lingering in school, wasting time. When Yumeki is eventually kicked out of his parents' house, he moves into Hotaru's apartment, but life together isn’t as easygoing as it was during their student days. Feeling frustrated, Yumeki begins to resent the “boring” Hotaru.

One night, everything changes when a drunken Hotaru kisses him, igniting something within Yumeki. He tells himself it’s all Hotaru’s fault, but in a moment of impulsive emotion, he ends up embracing him in the spur of the moment...

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: さよなら、モラトリアム。

183355.description:
Mitsuru is a heavy smoker who runs a handyman shop in Yugawara. He's loved by the people of the town, but he has a special power...?

(Source: Aokishi, translated)

title.native: 煙の向こうに声が聞こえる
title.romaji: Kemuri no Mukou ni Koe ga Kikoeru

synonyms: チキンハートセレナーデ　番外編

title.native: チキンハートセレナーデ another story

183358.description:
Se-Jong, a middle school Korean language teacher, finds himself facing his former students, who are now parents. Back in their school days, these students liked Se-Jong, but even now as adults, they’re trying to win over their former teacher. Can Se-Jong resist the charms and advances of his past students?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
synonyms: 危ない再会 ~オトナになった元教え子の誘惑~

183359.description:
Noeul enters university with dreams of studying film, her stomach full of butterflies. There, she meets Juheon, a student with an overwhelming presence that captivates everyone around him. Despite the attention he garners from others, Juheon displays a peculiar attitude towards Noeul—neither purely ill-tempered nor genuinely kind. Caught in a whirlwind of confusing emotions, Noeul finds herself falling into a passionate and feverish romance with Juheon. However, unforeseen circumstances force her to confront a harsh reality, leading to a cold and abrupt breakup. Ten years later, fate brings Noeul and Juheon back together. What will become of their unresolved feelings and unfinished story?

(Source: Lezhin US)

183360.description:
Shuu, a popular video game player, is a gay man who hides insecurities behind his confident persona. When he is contacted by his favorite game creator, known only as “unknown,” about a collaboration project, he eagerly agrees to meet in person. Despite being the complete opposite of his usual type, Shuu finds an unexpected connection with him. They quickly hit it off, leading to an invitation to each other’s homes, even though it's their first meeting.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Zero Centimeter between Your Eyes and Mine

title.native: 瞳が重なるゼロセンチ

183361.description:
The "Demon Masks" - malevolent entities that lurk in the shadows of human hearts. Kotaro, descendant of demon exorcists, has honed his skills to banish the mask possessing his childhood friend Asuka. But Asuka's power has exceeded his expectations...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

183362.description:
After having been suspended from the world of the gods as punishment, Solange has decided to start up a lunch cart in the human world...

(Source: K MANGA)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title.english: The Devil's in the Lunch Deals

title.native: ホラー映画に出てくるエロい女は絶対に死ぬ
title.romaji: Horror Eiga ni Detekuru Eroi Onna wa Zettai ni Shinu

183366.description: A man has repeated late night encounters with a mysterious, beautiful mermaid.

183367.description:
For Paula, not a single day passed by without a reminder of her ugliness. But it was her hideous face that spared her from being sold to a brothel or dying tragically like her sisters. So when Paula's father sells her off to work at an esteemed nobleman's mansion, she realizes that peasant girls are a disposable resource. However, she finds the young Count Belunita tucked away in an annex, shamefully hidden from the curious eyes of the public. And as Paula struggles to appeal to her tyrannical master's whims, she must also embrace her role as his secret maid.

(Source: WEBTOON)

183368.description:
Han-Eul, self-proclaimed campus flirt, has big dreams of landing a relationship in college. But one day, he stumbles upon a grim-looking man in what seems to be a shady drug dealer—and bolts in terror. Fate, however, has other plans. Han-Eul runs into the supposed drug dealer, Choi Da-Jeong, once again in a club he only joined to follow his crush. But before he knows it, he ends up at his place! A fluffy, sweet whirlwind romance between the slightly airheaded Han-Eul and the unexpectedly charming Da-Jeong unfolds!

(Source: Lezhin US)

183369.description:

Gifted by the heavens yet cursed by fate, Yeonshin was born with unimaginable talent in martial arts. But this very gift condemned him to a life that would end before adulthood. With the right opportunities, he had the potential to become a legendary hero, or the reincarnation of the Heavenly Demon. (Source: WEBTOON)

183378.description:
While working undercover at Heaven's Harvest Sect, a cult devoted to a so-called god of abundance, journalist Jang Gi-Jun expects the usual lies and fanaticism. Instead, he finds Hui-Sae, a young and eerily serene cult leader forced to "share blessings" through his own body, offering himself to frenzied followers in rituals disguised as salvation. Convinced he's on to a bigger scoop that expected, Gi-Jun watches the lines blur between devotion and exploitation, quickly realizing that the cult’s darkest secrets may lie not in its doctrine, but in what it demands of the one they claim is divine.

(Source: Lezhin US)

"We've known each other ever since we were in diapers. I thought I knew everything there was to know about him."

Natsuo attends the same college as his childhood friend Misaki. Campus life for the two has been going swimmingly. And because of their overwhelmingly good looks, these two never have a shortage of girls lined up after them. At a drinking party one night, Natsuo learns that Misaki acts surprisingly cute and spoiled with his girlfriend, a stark contrast to his usual aloofness. Shock soon transforms into obsession, as Natsuo begins thinking about Misaki every waking moment...! When it comes to Misaki, he has to see it all! His cute side, his body...

183382.description:
With no friends, family, or romance to speak of, Haruka has lived his life just going through the motions—until the day he awakens in the body of a beautiful, and womanly, dark elf! Suddenly, a world beyond his wildest imagination awaits, and uncontainable excitement races through him. There's just one problem: He gave up on putting himself out there a long time ago and has no idea how to strike up a conversation with other people. Teenagers and (other) women are certainly no exception.

But with a bottomless well of mana and a ridiculously tough body to boot, Haruka won't let any overthinking get in the way this time. Little by little, the dark elf works past his (her) fears and self-doubt, forging deep bonds with precious new friends and growing together with them. So begins a heartwarming story of an old man determined to make the most of this new fantastical lease on life!

Akihiko's two older sisters are beautiful women with big breasts and great figures, but they treat their younger brother badly. Ritsuko, the eldest sister, is serious and strict, and finds Akihiko's slightest mistake and scolds him, while Makoto, the second sister, is clever and dodges Ritsuko's anger and pushes troublesome tasks onto Akihiko. Fed up with this, Akihiko finally decides to take revenge. He receives a hypnosis device from his senior, and if you call the smartphone containing the device and give orders, the other person will obediently follow. Akihiko takes advantage of an opportunity to successfully plant the device in Ritsuko and make Makoto believe that it is their duty as sisters to satisfy their brother's sexual desires. Since then, Akihiko continues to train them. He awakens Ritsuko's hidden masochistic desires through humiliation play and anal training, and makes her more dependent on Akihiko. Jade has his hands full making treats, worrying about what foods Mao likes, and keeping an eye on him so he doesn't sneak away! Everything is for the sake of raising Mao to be a kind-hearted Satan who can bridge the gap between demons and humans. However, Louie is of no help at all! On Chicken Island, there is a no-good assassin named Wu Liuqi who is forced to work part-time at a hair salon to make a living. Scissors are his weapon of choice. 183438.description:
Onoda finds himself in a dire situation, chased by a gang of thugs, only to be rescued by Shimada—someone he used to bully in school. Shimada has undergone a remarkable transformation from a shy, bespectacled boy into a strikingly handsome man. Now, Onoda, burdened by debt and working as a freelancer, feels a mix of desperation and confusion. After saving him, Shimada unexpectedly kisses Onoda and confesses his love. Onoda’s instincts kick in, and he worries that Shimada is seeking revenge for their past. However, Shimada proposes a deal: he will pay off Onoda's debts in exchange for his compliance with whatever Shimada desires. Reluctantly, Onoda agrees, but his curiosity leads him to snoop through Shimada's locker. What he discovers—a large wad of cash and a gun...?

(Source; Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183440.description:
How far would you be willing to go for love? The unavoidable temptation to destroy one’s deepening love is an age-old dilemma for many. This provocative collection of love stories will show you how dangerous passion can sometimes be.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Stories included:
1. Bulgeunbamui Yeonindeul (붉은밤의 연인들, The Lovers of Crimson Night)
2. Relivable-ui Ice Cream (리리버블의 아이스크림, Riri Bubble's Ice Cream)
3. Dohwa♡Jupasu (도화♡주파수, Love Frequency )
4. Gocheungbildingeseo Tteoreojin Geu Gaemineun (고층빌딩에서 떨어진 그 개미는, The Ant that Fell from a High-rise)
5. Orange Scandal (오렌지 스캔들)

183442.description:
Is this love natural instinct or fate? Koharu is born to a bloodline who can read people's minds. Although he told himself he would never open up to anyone besides his family, those plans are thrown off when he meets an eccentric girl by the name of Yuki. With their encounter, Koharu begins to fall deeper and deeper... into the pit of romance!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: Magokoro Scramble! What Lies in Your Heart?

183443.description: Winner of the Special Encouragement Award and Takeshi Yasuda Award in the 97th Weekly Shonen Magazine Newcomer Manga Contest.

183444.description:
Yorisue, who works at a lesbian bar, falls in love with a beautiful customer, Wasa. Yorisue tries to tempt her into a one-night stand, and Wasa is willing to go with the flow. The next morning, after a very satisfying night together, Yorisue is shocked to see Wasa's different appearance in the morning! This is a romantic comedy about falling love while accepting the gap between the day and night faces!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 一夜で堕ちる恋なんて

183445.description:
Office worker Saeki Senharu is forced to pay off her debts after her father's company goes bankrupt. One day, Ritsu Kaido, a charismatic young CEO who leads the business world, asks Senbalu to marry him on contract in order to inherit his late father's estate. A loveless marriage... Senharu thinks that they will someday be a couple who understand each other, but he has a mistress...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Ruthless Heir Wants Me Pregnant to Wed!
title.native: 冷酷御曹司は身籠り婚をご所望です！
title.romaji: Reikoku Onzoushi wa Mikomori Kon wo Goshomou desu

183446.description:
Narumi, a hardworking but plain office worker, hides a secret from her colleagues: her traumatic dating history, which has led her to take on her alter ego, the popular live streamer Minarin. Her charming coworker, Shinonome, seems like her opposite — handsome, charismatic, and admired by all — but struggles with his own insecurities. When an unexpected taxi ride forces their secrets into the open, they make a deal... to help “train” each other to overcome their touch aversion and fear of intimacy!

As Narumi begins to see Shinonome as a path toward healing, they must confront their pasts together. Can this mismatched pair help each other find solace in shared vulnerability?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.native: 東雲くんとはデキない関係

183447.description:
Beneath the surface of ordinary school life lurks a punk-rock reality. Kashiwabara's expressions of love for Komori are intense and unconventional. Will her rockin' yet bittersweet affection ever reach Komori's heart...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: ユカちゃんの愛情表現

183448.description:
Two balconies so close that even children can come and go. A childhood friend who comes over every day. He thought that this peaceful daily life, although a little rowdy sometimes, would go on forever. That is, until he came along…

One day, Yuichi's big-breasted and slightly absent-minded childhood friend, Maki, picks up a cat named Mirumo, who for some reason speaks human language!

Will Mirumo-sama be the Cupid who brings Yuichi and Maki together?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

183449.description:
Together with the spoiled and mischievous stepsister who loves me...

This is the R-18 sequel for the manga Ore no Ie no Koakuma Imouto depicting them after the ending of the main story.

This work can be enjoyed by itself, but if you read the preceding series you may enjoy this even more.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

Note: Released at Comiket 102.
synonyms: Flirty Love H with the Little Devil Sister Who Became My Lover

title.native: 恋人同士になった小悪魔妹といちゃらぶH
title.romaji: Koibito Doushi ni Natta Koakuma Imouto to Icha Love H

183450.description:
High school student Eun Nu-Ri is a writer who wrote a hugely popular novel, but because the novel was published under her older sister's name, her real identity was a secret known only to her sister and Nu-Ri. Then one day, while Nu-Ri was going about her daily life as usual, characters from the novel, who call themselves 'otherworlders', appear in front of her and demand to be sent back to their original world. When Nu-Ri realizes something is wrong, she struggles to fix it. Will the main characters in the novel be able to safely return to their original story worlds?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 내가 쓴 소설 속 주인공들이 나를 죽이려 드는데요?
title.romaji: Naega Sseun Soseol Song Juingongdeuri Nareul Jugiryeo Deuneundeyo?

183451.description:
A son who accompanies his old father, who spends the rest of his life in a nursing home, to an outpatient clinic at the hospital once a month. The outpatient clinic is the only time he goes out and is a time for short, awkward conversations between father and son. The son tries to reconcile psychologically with his father by retracing the past and present together. And the son's children, a hidden story of three generations.

(Source: Naver, translated)

183453.description:
Ritsu Matsuoka is a bit of a natural airhead. When he discovers a small love letter on his classroom desk signed with an unknown address, he impulsively replies with a cheerful “I love you too.” This playful exchange of letters makes his otherwise boring classes a lot more exciting. However, his friend’s comment, “What if it’s a serious confession?” keeps nagging at him. One day, while returning to the classroom to retrieve something he forgot, Ritsu unexpectedly encounters Satsuki Hayato, a blonde-haired yankee known for his tough demeanor. As Ritsu sneaks a glance, he notices Satsuki blushing and writing something on the desk. Could it be? The mysterious author of the letters is none other than this intimidating yet intriguing younger boy?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: ひよこ、黄色いアヒルに恋をする
title.romaji: Hiyoko, Kiiroi Ahiru ni Koi wo Suru

183454.description:
Ryotaro, a popular actor whose personal life is a mess, crosses paths with a beautiful young man named Kei, who his girlfriend has just dumped. As they talk, Kei reveals that he often cares for others, sometimes too much, prompting Ryotaro to open up about his own struggles. When a stalker fan discovers Ryotaro's home, he temporarily moves into Kei's room. He finds comfort in Kei's nurturing nature, but everything shifts when Kei unexpectedly sees Ryotaro masturbating one day...

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)
synonyms: From the kiss the rest is ad-lib

title.native: キスから先はアドリブで
title.romaji: Kiss Kara Saki wa Ad-lib de

183455.description:
Izuki comes from a wealthy family and boasts a model-like appearance, but beneath the surface, he harbors a serious middle-aged man fetish. His ideal partner is distinctly "middle-aged." One day, he meets Tetsuharu Matsuda, a handyman who arrives to exterminate a beehive at his home. Captivated by Tetsuharu, Izuki seizes the opportunity when Tetsuharu accidentally breaks an expensive vase. He proposes a deal: “Going on a date for 30,000 yen per each time,” and "Having sex for 50,000 yen each time." Will this unconventional arrangement lead to the connection Izuki desires?

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183456.description:
Li Jiu, a renowned beauty in Bejing social circles, got drunk one night and accidentally harassed the movie star Pei Shisi. The video of her groping his butt went viral all over the net! Little did people know, the two are actually childhood friends, and Pei Shisi has had a secret crush on her for many years. That night, he had just found out she has been going on matchmaking dates, and he was trying to seduce her instead.

"Come on, Jiu-er, forget those lousy guys, how about give me a chance—?"

But Li Jiu doesn't want to get into trouble by having anything to do with him! Trying to clear up rumors about them, she goes on a dating show, only to fall further into his non-stop doting pursuit…

(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)
synonyms: Tease Me Publicly! Tempt Me Secretly! Be Lovey-Dovey on Variety Show With the Super Famous Film Emperor

title.native: 明撩！暗诱！和顶流影帝恋综撒糖
title.romaji: Ming Liao! An You! He Dingliu Yingdi Lian Zong Sa Tang

183457.description:
Human emotions are behind these gruesome murder cases. Each with a meticulously designed twist! Enjoy these mysteries by the master of the genre!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Volume 1:
1. Gakuensai Satsujin Jiken (学園祭殺人事件)
2. Shuugaku Ryokou Satsujin Jiken (修学旅行殺人事件)

Volume 2:
1. En no Naka no Satsujin Jiken (円の中の殺人事件)
2. Piano Sonata Satsujin Jiken (ピアノソナタ殺人事件)

Volume 3:
1. Koukan Nikki Satsujin Jiken (交換日記殺人事件)
2. Rikashitsu Satsujin Jiken (理科室殺人事件)

title.native: 高階良子殺人事件セレクション

183458.description:
The Devon family sits on a mountain of debt and they are on the brink of bankruptcy. This is no fault of hers of course, but Courtney Devon has always been the one painted as the villain in her family. However, the family is in dire straits and they have to do something, anything, to raise some money and get out of this situation. But then one day, news arrives from the Imperial Palace that His Royal Highness the crown prince has decided to make Courtney the crown princess. Seemingly a typical prince on the outside, His Royal Highness is actually quite a troublemaker with a dark side. Will this arrangement end up solving Courtney Devon’s problems or just complicating things further? Will a love against all odds bloom or will someone end up in the doghouse...?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Un perro vive en el jardín imperial
เปิดข้อเสนอลับ วิวาห์ร้าย

183459.description:
I've been reincarnated. Into a novel I used to enjoy in my past life, no less! My name is Renatis, and I'll be playing the part of little sister to the female lead in this dark, tragic whirlwind of a story where a beastly bad boy shatters my sister's hopes, dreams, and her life. My sister is too good and too beautiful, and I'm not about to let that happen to my perfect sister. So, I'm taking charge. I shall turn this dark, tragic story into a heartwarming tale of healing. I will save my sister.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: How to Change a Tragedy Novel Into a Healing One
เปลี่ยนบทร้ายให้เป็นบทรัก
暗黑变治愈的改写方法
治癒暗黑系男主的方法

title.english: Changing the Genre From Angst to Heartwarming

183460.description:
Hideyoshi Hashiba transfers to Sennokuni High School, and he is immediately noticed by Nobunaga Oda, the brash but dum b girl sitting next to him. She forces him to join the Tenkafubu club, a club that aims to "unify Japan"... A big, dumb comedy performed by a bunch of Sengoku-style weirdos!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 二人だけのオネスティ
俺が買ってもいいですか?
title.romaji: Ore ga Katte mo Ii desu ka?

title.native: お母さんはソープの匂い

183466.description:
This is a story about a cross-dressing boy “Ao” and their sensible(?) older friend “Hana.” Ao is a beautiful girl(?) who catches people's eye and confuses them about their gender, but Ao is a real "femboy" who wears a sailor-suit uniform and has a major crush on the older girl next door.... The love story unfolds with their neighbors and friends.

(Source: Pulcomi, translated)

synonyms: Little Sister's Heart and the Spring Sky
Imouto Kokoro to Haru no Sora

title.romaji: Imouto Gokoro to Haru no Sora

183468.description:
Yuri Shirai is a shy otaku who has landed a job at a publishing company. But instead of becoming a manga editor like she hoped for, she is assigned to the sales department! What's more, she is put in charge of a women's fashion magazine, a subject she knows nothing about! Yuri is worried because her image of the sales department is a place full of extroverted people with good communication skills. But under the guidance of a senior colleague, Amane Kotake, she will learn the tricks of the trade as a newbie salesperson....... You will definitely be encouraged by Yuri, who tries her best despite the difficulties ahead! A work comedy with lots of laughter sprinkled with a few tears!

(Source: Alphapolis, translated)

title.native: 陰キャオタクでも営業やれますか？

183469.description:
1. Buaisou na P Cup Deka Chichi Onna no Watashi wa Musuko no Guragura Shishunki Kintama wo Kara ni Suru Tame no Otegaru Sakusei Obenjo Desu (無愛想なPカップデカチチ女の私は息子のグラグラ思春期金玉を空にするためのお手軽搾精お便所です♥)
2. Buaisou na P Cup Mama no Ero Teku ni Dohamarishita Boku-kun! Kondo wa Onee-chan no L Cup Bakunyuu Omitsugi Gohoushi ni Dai Koufun no Hanshoku Sanmai! (無愛想なPカップママのエロテクにドはまりしたボクくん!今度はお姉ちゃんのLカップ爆乳お貢（みつぎ）ご奉仕に大興奮の繁殖三昧!)
