4. Chichishibori wo Otetsudai! B 110cm (O Cup) no Muboubi Obo-Ane wa Boku no Meushi Onaho (乳搾りをお手伝い!B110cm（Oカップ）の無防備叔母姉はぼくの雌牛オナホ)
5. P Cup Buaisou Mama, L cup Kasshoku Onee-chan no Jouji Hatsujou RabuRabu Ninkatsu [Kakioroshi] (Pカップ無愛想ママ、Lカップ褐色お姉ちゃんの常時発情ラブラブ妊活（描き下ろし）)

title.native: 爆乳美熟女は即ハメ交尾穴
title.romaji: Bakunyuu Bijukujo wa Soku Hame Koubi Ana

183470.description:
Rio managed to get into the high school of her dreams. By coincidence (?), Shion, who went to elementary school with her, is a senpai at the same school. And he begins to constantly get in her hair...! Can she escape!? A romantic comedy about fate that resembles a sweet hell.

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

title.native: ハンドメイドロマンチック
親父の肉棒でよがりまくっていた幼馴染
title.romaji: Oyaji no Nikubou de Yogarimakutteita Osananajimi

183479.description:
This is the long-awaited spin-off of Watashitachi ga Koisuru Riyuu!

A new love story unfolds between Itami – secretly in love with his boss Kurosawa and quietly heartbroken – and Imamura, his childhood friend and colleague who has been keeping an eye on him...!?

183480.description:
1. Garakutamachi Kitan Part 1 Atama ni Saku Hana (我楽多街奇譚 第１話「頭に咲く花」)
2. Garakutamachi Kitan Part 2 Doubutsuen Nite (我楽多街奇譚 第２話「動物園にて」)
3. Garakutamachi Kitan Part 3 Watashi wa Ika Nishite Inryoku to Te wo Nigitta ka? (我楽多街奇譚第３話「私はいかにして引力と手をにぎったか？」)
4. Ehoba Hakase no Shinryoushitsu (江帆波博士の診療室)
5. Shokkaku (触角)
6. Atarashii Ningyou (新しい人形)
7. Wakusei LOVE no Houkai (惑星ＬＯＶＥの崩壊)
8. Kamen Shounen (仮面少年)
9. Hai, Okaasama (ハイ、オカアサマ)
10. Kouya (荒野)

183482.description:
Miyake has more cats than any other town in Japan, and Ichika is crazy about all of them. If she could be friends with cats, she probably would. Especially since Ichika hasn't spoken to her childhood friend, Maki, for over a year at this point... After Ichika realizes her and her estranged bestie are now classmates, she becomes determined to rekindle what they once had. But Maki is skittish, withdrawn, and never gives Ichika a chance to get close—until a magical cat's curse changes their relationship forever...

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: My Childhood Friend Meows Under the Skirt
title.native: 幼馴染は、にゃあと鳴いてスカートのなか
title.romaji: Osananajimi wa, Nyaa to Naite Skirt no Naka

183483.description:
When I saw “Maki Saihara” listed in the roster of my new class, the weight of that name made me feel as if I can't move at all. Maki is a dear childhood friend, but we haven't spoken in over a year.

(How did I talk to Maki......?)
The distance between me and my childhood friend seems very far, even though she is sitting right next to me in the same classroom. Until one day, when Maki suddenly comes over to my house.

"Ichika, I want to show you something."

Something suddenly pops out of her head. Cat ears! In no time at all, the distance that had separated us disappears. Now Maki, whose personality has become like that of a cat as well, comes and lies down next to me, rubs herself against me, and spoils me with just the two of us in this carefree time.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 幼馴染は、にゃあと鳴いてスカートのなか
title.romaji: Osananajimi wa, Nyaa to Naite Skirt no Naka

title.native: SNSで大人気なレイヤーが私を誘ってオフパコの話。～着せ替えセックス編～
title.romaji: SNS de Daininki na Layer ga Watashi wo Sasotte Off-Pako no Hanashi. Kisegae Sex-hen

183485.description:
Takuma Ben Maier. As his name suggests, he is a boy with a foreign father and a Japanese mother. Moreover, his father is the king of the Kingdom of Maia, with the world's 10th largest oil reserve. However, he is only the 100th in line to the throne, so he is content living an ordinary life in Japan with his mother, because he figured he would never get the chance to succeed the king. However, one day, the plane carrying his fathers and siblings crashes, killing them all. Takuma suddenly finds himself the heir to the throne, and Takuma's life changes drastically, as he tries to fend off a harem of women flocking to him for his money, including his own homeroom teacher, a TV reporter, and an idol, with only a beautiful brown-skinned ninja girl sent from his father's kingdom to protect him as bodyguard.

(Source: Momoiro Angel, translated)

title.native: 王位継承1位の男 ～ハラませ天国の歪なお妃選び～
title.romaji: Oui Keishou 1-i no Otoko: Harem Tengoku no Ibitsuna Ohi Erabi

183488.description:
In order to achieve her goal, Yumeko Makino starts playing the game Vivid Monsters Chronicles (a.k.a. Vivimon).
This manga follows her and her friends who she meets along the way, in game and in real life.

title.native: ビビッド・モンスターズ・クロニクル

183489.description:
When a royal kiss fails to wake the sleeping beauty in the forest, young Prince Cedric figures a knife to the throat should do the trick. Lucky for Ariel, she awakens from her long slumber just in time to avoid a funeral at the age of 1000. Unlucky for her, she has now become the object of the twisted prince’s obsession. Though she manages to banish him from the forest for a decade, Cedric finds his way back stronger than ever as the emperor. After setting her home ablaze, he has just one thing in mind: “Let’s get married, Ariel.”

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: The Emperor, A Thousand Years Younger Than Me, Is Obsessed
จักรพรรดิคลั่งรักที่เด็กกว่าฉันพันปี

title.english: The Young Emperor is Obsessed With Me

183490.description:
One shall become a king, and the other shall become a sacrifice for the king. On the day Crown Princes Tae Chan-Ryang and Tae Ho-Wol were born, a prophecy descended from the heavens. Who will be the one to survive?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Words of The Beloved Sun

183491.description:
"Why does the Dragon King seek a rabbit?

Cheong-wan, a turtle from the Dragon King’s palace, ventures onto land to retrieve the liver of a rabbit to cure the ailing king. By sheer luck, he encounters the elusive rabbit almost immediately upon arrival. Determined to bring the rabbit back to the Underwater Kingdom, Cheong-wan is prepared to do whatever it takes.

""And how will you convince me?""
""Sorry?""
""If I go to the Dragon King's palace, what will you do for me in return, Cheong-wan?""

Cheong-wan finds himself mesmerized by the rabbit Jeok-ran's playful smile and enigmatic words. He realizes that to succeed, he must go to far lengths.

Thus begins a perilous and enchanting journey, as Cheong-wan navigates a world filled with unexpected challenges and mysterious allurements, where the stakes are as high as the depths of the Dragon King's palace."

(Source: Lezhin US)

183492.description:
Lee Shin-Hui has always juggled odd jobs to support his ailing brother, but when he accidentally shatters a mysterious marble, he's dragged into a demonic realm! Just as all hope seems lost, he's rescued by a powerful dokkaebi named Ohwi, who demands Shin-Hui's soul qi to satisfy his own hunger. Trapped in a dangerous world and bound to Ohwi's desires, can Shin-Hui find a way back home, or is he doomed to become Ohwi's personal soul qi vessel forever?

(Source: Lezhin US)

183493.description:
Gu Qingying and Fu Shiyu are a couple of girlfriends, the duo are studying in a dance academy, Gu Qingying is known as a genius dancer, but also in school during the professional dance troupe, she is such a perfect pair of lovers, but Gu Qingying one day without saying goodbye to declare a breakup, from then on, for four years, Fu Shiyu has been looking for Gu Qingying until one day, on the dark stage of the bar, she saw a big change in style, it is a dance sexy and hot! Gu Qingying...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

183494.description:
Sakisaka Reon, who works at a boys' bar, doesn’t have a specific partner but spreads his affection to “anyone who says they like me,” regardless of gender.

One day, while at a café, he is cornered by a regular customer from the bar, resulting in him getting splashed with water and feeling like a drenched rat. The café owner, Hodaka Shuusuke, reaches out to him. Shuusuke is a gentle, kind man, and from that day on, he treats Reon with warmth and affection.

At first, Reon feels a flutter of anxiety, but as Shuusuke listens to his problems, he begins to open up for the first time and there he experiences sex with him as the bottom. Reon discovers that sex with a little bit of BDSM with Shuusuke satisfies him both physically and emotionally. However, he struggles to imagine being loved by someone consistently...

(Sourece: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 恋するミルククラウン

183495.description:
"Aiken" can mean "beloved dog," or in our case, love that takes the form of a dog.

A is the big dog who was always gave us smiles as a part of our family. Until one day when we were told that his days were numbered… Our last days together were lively yet gentle. A comic essay depicting the warm memories of a beloved dog, their life as its caretakers, and the day when they had to say goodbye.

(Source: Bunshun, translated)

183496.description:
Amane Yui is a mysterious young man with the ability to heal injuries. One day, in a secluded alley, a man named Harumi, covered in wounds, begs him for help. Though Yui has always avoided others because of his powers, he feels compelled to help Harumi and decides to take him home. However, as Yui tends to his injuries, he finds himself unexpectedly drawn to Harumi's beauty. In return for his kindness, Harumi gives Yui a blowjob that leaves him breathless...!

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

183498.description:
Rui Hotaka is a Switch: someone who can become a Dom or a Sub. While using a dating app, he has an encounter with Reo, a Dom with an overwhelmingly appealing voice. His teasing commands and gentle touch fill Rui with a sensation he's never experienced before, and he's almost certain that this man must be his soulmate. Except...the next morning, he finds the bed completely empty. Rui is disheartened over getting smashed and dashed...but in some odd twist of fate, he sees Reo at his workplace?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183500.description:
Chihiro, a handsome gay bartender, has never had anyone treat him as their true love. One day, he runs into Ritsu, a high school classmate he once loved, and begins to envy the happiness Ritsu seems to enjoy with his partner. Eventually, Chihiro develops a dark obsession with Ritsu, who often visits his bar...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183501.description:
Amami, a butler for the prestigious Shisenin family, is approached by a man named Igarashi, who recently rescued Keiko, the daughter of the family head. What could Igarashi want with him...?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183503.description:
Rakini is the king of Haleiwa, a peaceful and tranquil tropical island kingdom. His gentle and laid-back personality makes him well-liked by the islanders, but he's not good at diplomacy, and his subjects, worried about the future of the kingdom, ask him to choose a queen from among the islanders in three days. Rakini tries to take Hiine, his favorite servant, who has great strength, as his queen, but she refuses the proposal at first…

(Source: Natalie, translated)

183504.description:
After graduating from junior college, Aina got married right away and became a full-time housewife. She thought she was a winner in life, until her husband asked for a divorce… Thrown out on the streets, Aina was planning to find a lawyer, but ended up going to a tax accountant by mistake… Will she be able to get her love and her life back?

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

Ayame Meita, a socially awkward high school boy who dreams of being a hero, sees news about ‘Magical Girl Majeri’ protecting humanity from monsters. As various speculations swirl about the mysterious magical girl, even becoming a topic in his class, Meita finds himself connecting with Shion Anri—a cute but tsundere gal who's completely isolated—all because of ‘Magical Girl Majeri’...!? When he learns the secret behind her loneliness, a heart-pounding, kindness-filled magical life begins!

(Source: Comic Meteor, translated)

In just one night, the Nouveau riche, Chen Chen, became broke and miserable. His girlfriend ran off with somebody else, and surprisingly, the culprit behind his tragedy was his own best friend. When Chen Chen almost got hit by a car, a mysterious system suddenly appeared. “Do you want to take revenge?” Chen Chen couldn't die in content that way. Since then, he got the Xue Ba system, which helped him take over the world and live without an opponent!

(Source: WebComics)

183519.description:
Imagine you are stuck inside a warehouse while the world is experiencing an apocalypse. That’s exactly what’s happening to Jeong-gyeom, except he suddenly awakens a very odd but powerful ability to store anything in a parallel dimension, giving him the tools to defeat the creatures wreaking havoc on the world. But as he ventures into the ravaged city of Seoul, he realizes there is more to this apocalypse than meets the eye as he encounters other survivors and mysterious monsters on his quest to find his family.

(Source: WEBTOON)

183522.description:
Han-Byuk isn’t thrilled when his new neighbor turns out to be the cold, aloof Yeo-Min. After hearing Yeo-Min moaning through their too-thin apartment walls and having an awkward interaction the next day, Han-Byuk gets a glimpse of his neighbor with his guard down. He's shy. Cute, even. Han-Byuk decides to double his efforts to befriend his neighbor and, surprised by each other and themselves, they grow closer until the lines of their friendship blurs into something...more.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes one side story chapter.

183523.description:
The world's best poker players are called 'sharks', and the most ruthless among them is known simply as Czar. Kim Yoon and a gang of thugs roam from house to house, seeking this legendary figure - despite rumors that no one ever returns from his domain. One day, a man in a red hoodie warns Yoon, "Sir, you'll die if you keep this up.” Ignoring the warning, Yoon leaves to gather money for a new game. Suddenly, he hears the chilling sound of bones smashing and bodies crushing. As the noise fades, Yoon finally comes face to face with Czar…but when he offers Yoon a chance to play, Yoon sees it as a golden opportunity and believes his life is about to change. "I'll try it."

(Source: Lezhin US)

183533.description:
Orianna, a regular office worker, dies in an accident due to exhaustion and is reincarnated as a villainess pursued by the antagonist in a romance novel.

To evade the tragic fate the malevolent prince has planned for her, she resolves to change her ways and establish herself as a distinguished lady in high society. However, despite her transformation, Orianna is betrayed by her fiancé, Reuben, framed for conspiracy, and condemned. Her unexpected savior from this dire situation turns out to be none other than her nemesis, Prince Dylan.

Even though their alliance in the novel originally led to the worst possible outcome, he is now her only hope. Despite being wary of Dylan's persistent overtures, circumstances force her into a pretend marriage with him.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

183534.description:
Ari is a headless grim reaper who has been guiding souls to the afterlife for hundreds of years. She has always felt unseen and unloved because no one can see her face. That all changes when she encounters Ucheol, a popular actor who can see her head and agrees to help her search for it. Will Ari find her missing head and reclaim her identity, finally freeing herself from a lifetime of loneliness?

(Source: WEBTOON)

183536.description:
As a dedicated vice president in a powerful corporate empire, Sang built his position through absolute diligence. Though adopted from humble origins, he earned the chairman’s complete trust. In contrast, the chairman’s biological son, Tae-Gon, was a notorious, reckless playboy. Sang’s carefully constructed world begins to crumble when Tae-Gon suddenly declares his intention to join the company. Expecting a fleeting whim, Sang is caught off guard when the bratty heir delivers remarkable results, threatening everything Sang has strived so hard to secure. Determined not to let his hard-won status slip away, Sang resolves to take matters into his own hands. However, controlling Tae-Gon proves far more complex than anticipated. Intense tension and unspoken desire ignite a high-stakes dynamic where the line between tamer and tamed rapidly blurs. Will he truly be able to tame the brat—or will he be the one to end up on a leash?

(Source: Lezhin US)

183543.description:
Before humans claimed their place in history, the skybound paradise of Hinoaruchi was ruled by demi-beings—creatures that appeared half human, half beast. The realm flourishes under the tenuous peace maintained by the demi-dragons of Ryujinkyo, until prophecy predicts the dawn of a new era shrouded in uncertainty. With the fate of the world hanging in the balance, will the birth of Kamuna, the first human child, bring disaster or salvation?

(Source: VIZ Media)

183544.description:
Aigasawa Namo, who loves the Showa-era idols she saw on TV when she was a child, set her sights on becoming an idol herself. However, her career does not go well, and her group is forced to disband. Trying to accept the reality of the situation, she stops by a shrine to pray, and is suddenly sucked into the ground. She wakes up in a place that looks a lot like Shibuya, but from a long time ago…? The power to never give up on your dreams creates a miracle. A nostalgic idol story!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title.native: アイドルミーツアイドル！

183545.description:
Having arrived in a world where the male-to-female ratio is 1:5, the man Shoto tries to live an ordinary life as he did in his previous world. However, he unknowingly causes many women to fall in love with him this way, and the women develop intense feelings for him.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Did You Think You Could Live Normally Even in a World with a 1:5 Male-to-Female Ratio?

title.native: 男女比1：5の世界でも普通に生きられると思った？　～激重感情な彼女たちが無自覚男子に翻弄されたら～
title.romaji: Danjohi 1:5 no Sekai demo Futsu ni Ikirareru to Omotta? Geki Juu Kanjou na Kanojotachi ga Mujikaku Danshi ni Honrousaretara

183546.description:
An ordinary man found himself transferred to another world which seems familiar, except there are more women than he was used to. But it looks like he has a household registration and can attend college....... So it's almost just like his life before, just a little more aggressive with women, right? He starts his new life with this naive idea. He doesn't even know. He doesn't know how much the women around him were touched by the simple kindness he showed, which was just regular good manners in his original world. Such that they begin to develop such intense feelings for him that their eyes would go dark the moment they see a hint of any other woman around him…

This is the story of a hero who unknowingly attracts a group of heroines just by living life in his normal way, until he finally “gets” that they might like him a little (a lot) more than he thought. The story is about a hero who has heroines falling in love with him without even realizing it!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 男女比1:5の世界でも普通に生きられると思った? ~激重感情な彼女たちが無自覚男子に翻弄されたら~
title.romaji: Danjohi 1:5 no Sekai demo Futsu ni Ikirareru to Omotta? Geki Juu Kanjou na Kanojotachi ga Mujikaku Danshi ni Honrousaretara

183547.description:
Irede: the world’s oldest pleasure town, built as an offering to a god. Here alone, myth has endured the passing of millennia. In a townscape dyed vermilion by the light of hanging lanterns, fine wine and masterful music sate the desires of guests who travel from across the continent to experience Irede’s wonders—and meet its beautiful courtesans. Yet all is not well here, as shades—supernatural entities born of human desires—lurk in the shadows, their motives known only to themselves, and deep beneath the earth, something primal stirs. When Xixu, a straight-laced military officer, arrives from the capital to become the town’s newest shadeslayer, he encounters Sari, a young courtesan with hair the color of moonlight. Thus begins a tale of love and conflict, of desire and blood, and of gods and men.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: 月の白さを知りてまどろむ
title.romaji: Tsuki no Shirosa wo Shirite Madoromu

183548.description:
After years of obscurity, rising star Sung Yi-Hyun is finally basking in the spotlight... Conquering dramas, variety shows, and the glitz of celebrity life. Then one day, he gets a single text from his longtime lover, Jang Tae-Eun:

“Let’s break up.”

Ghosted. Dumped. By text. One of the three ultimate breakup sins. Furious, Yi-Hyun swears to live his best, wildest life—eating well, partying hard, and pretending not to care. But Tae-Eun doesn’t even flinch.

“Don’t tell me… he’s seeing someone else?”

When Yi-Hyun storms over to confront him, he's greeted not by his ex—but by the biggest, brightest full moon he’s ever seen. And just like that, the secret he’s kept hidden for years is exposed… along with a tail and a pair of ears. Mistaken for a stray and taken in by Tae-Eun, Yi-Hyun suddenly finds himself living under the same roof as his ex— not as a man, but as a dog named Rufus.

A sweet ex, a secret shifter, and one very suspiciously adorable dog— let the dangerously cute cohabitation begin!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Curse of the Full Moon

183549.description:
Ha-Jin has suffered relentless torment from a stalker ever since he was outed… Pushed to both the metaphorical and physical edge, he sees no way out. Just as he’s ready to give up on life, an unexpected savior appears: an angel named Kael. But this isn’t your typical heaven-sent rescue. Kael offers a shady deal: he’ll get rid of Ha-Jin’s stalker, but in return, he wants Ha-Jin’s soul. With nothing left to lose, Ha-Jin agrees...only to learn firsthand what “touched by an angel” really means.

(Source: Lezhin US)

183550.description:
Born from the legendary love between humans and dragons, the hybrid race known as Drik looks human but carries the strength, regeneration, and instinct of dragons, including a powerful heat cycle that returns again and again. Among them, Sieric Lorence stands apart, his bloodline so rich with dragon power that he has become an unrivaled knight. Sent by royal command to rescue researchers trapped in ancient ruins, Sieric crosses paths with Jahid, a petty thief trying to steal his sword, a blade forged from dragon bones. As Sieric prepares to punish him, fate strikes cruelly. His heat arrives unexpectedly, and without suppressants, he is left dangerously vulnerable. Noticing his condition, Jahid makes a bold offer. As a fellow Drik, he can help Sieric endure the heat, but only in exchange for his freedom.

In the heart of forgotten ruins, surrounded by danger and desire, a risky bargain is struck that could change both of their fates forever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

183551.description: Murder, escape, theft, stalking! Jaeho misunderstands Taein as a criminal, but due to a film project assignment, they become a team, and in the process of getting to know him, Jaeho is swept up by Taein, who is direct and forward with his feelings. These two, with the contrasting titles of "Endless NG" (No Good/mistake) and "Retake Master," will they really be able to finish shooting the movie successfully?

183552.description:
Vampires are beings that are close to beings of the demigod. They live by blending in with human society. Edward (nickname: Eddie), a vampire with weak supernatural powers, approaches Joshua, a nerd who seems easy to hunt. Seeing Joshua following him obediently, Eddie is filled with anticipation that he will finally succeed in hunting, but Joshua misunderstands that Eddie is going to suck his X?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: Let me suck in〜ヴァンパイアの僕が扱うのはそっちじゃなくて⁉︎〜
[ナニワ極道伝] 殺てもうたれや！

title.native: 悩殺♥ひながせマダム〜熟女アイドル奮戦記〜

183557.description:
Mana and Tsukushi are childhood friends who each has a complex about their relationship. Although they care deeply about each other, both of them are afraid to reveal their true feelings. Suddenly, a girl who calls herself "the girl from the future" appears before them and their unrequited love. What is the girl's purpose? And what will become of Mana and Tsukushi's relationship? A girl-meet-suspense story intertwined with life, death, and children!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

183558.description:
A short 4-chapter series about how two kids spent their summer!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

183559.description: One day, Takechiyo, the eldest son and heir to the third shogun, Iemitsu, was attacked by a group of Negoro ninjas. Why would the Shogun's own secret service target the heir to the Shogun's throne? Seven samurai, including Ishikawa Gyobu, a powerful swordsman who is Takechiyo's personal guard, confront the band of assassins, each using his own special skills. The clash between the seven samurai and the band of assassins grows more intense with each battle......
synonyms: 将軍家光の乱心 激突

title.native: オナホ合宿催眠ドスケベインタビュー
痴女医葵ハルカの診療室
人妻詩子の転落～罠に堕ちた人妻～
title.romaji: Hitozuma Utako no Tenraku: Wana ni Ochita Hitozuma

183563.description:
In the land of Shouran, where the Kirin is the elder and the Byakko (White Tiger), Seiryuu (Azure Dragon), Suzaku (Vermilion Bird), and Genbu (Black Tortoise) guard the four directions, the social order is absolute. The hierarchy consists of "Rulers: Alpha," "Servants: Beta," and "Followers: Omega." In this world, birthright is an undeniable law. Ayato, who had been forced since childhood to become one of the Four Divine Beasts—Byakko, a noble Alpha—despised the rigid class system of this world. However, one day, after helping a mixed-blood Beta named Mamiya who was being bullied, Ayato decided to keep Mamiya by his side. Though he had initially loathed the social ranks, he used his status to make Mamiya his personal attendant, albeit somewhat forcefully. Now, Ayato finds himself troubled by the consequences of his actions...

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title.native: 恋華抄《四神×オメガバース》

183564.description:
For her lover of 10 years, belle of the ball Julia Rapiere played the part of a sheltered flower in a greenhouse. That is, until he betrayed her by having an affair with her trusted maid. Bent on revenge, Julia reveals her true colors, and the demure flower transforms into a fearsome monster.

(Source: Manta)

183565.description:
The genius hacker Gu Chu was reincarnated into the world of a tragic romance novel as a cute five-year old girl. Her mother is the doomed heroine who will suffer a bad ending. Her father is an arrogant corporate CEO who is oblivious to their troubles. They are surrounded by scheming relatives, like the two-faced auntie and many other conspirators. So it's up to Gu Chu to stand up for her mother. Nobody would suspect a five-year old child? She's just trying to protect her mother, while fighting for a billion-dollar inheritance.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: The Fickle President's Exclusive Cutie Pie
穿成虐文女主的亲闺女

title.native: 薄情总裁的专属小奶包
title.romaji: Boqing Zongcai De Zhuanshu Xiao Nai Bao

183566.description:
The daughter of a minor noble, Amelia hails from a remote agricultural domain. From an early age, she has been engaged to Reese, who can provide the earth magic her domain needs. Though it was only meant to be a political marriage, they got along well—until recently. Since Reese began attending the Royal Academy of Magic, he's become oddly distant and stopped contacting Amelia. Now that it's time for Amelia to enroll too, she hopes to find some answers but she still can't get ahold of Reese, and it's tough to make friends among the upper-class students at the academy. Can anyone help her through this disheartening experience? A dashing prince, perhaps...?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: A Royal Rebound: Forget My Ex-Fiancé, I'm Being Pampered by the Prince!
title.native: 婚約者が浮気相手と駆け落ちしました。王子殿下に溺愛されて幸せなので、今さら戻りたいと言われても困ります。
title.romaji: Konyakusha ga Uwaki Aite to Kakeochi Shimashita. Ouji Denka ni Dekiai Sarete Shiawase na node, Imasara Modoritai to Iwaretemo Komarimasu.

183568.description:
The legendary hero, Theo, is as brave as they come. With the help of his three beautiful comrades, nothing can stop him! ...Or so he thought. But after a quest one day, he tries out a mysterious potion that paralyzes him from head to toe! His comrades carry him to bed... only to whip out their dicks!? Sorry Theo, I know you were saving yourself for that girl back home, but these three horny dickgirls can't wait any longer!

(Source: Fakku!)

title.english: He Might Be the Legendary Hero, but He's Not Immune to Paralysis!
title.native: 最強の勇者ですが仲間に無力化されて襲われました。
title.romaji: Saikyou no Yuusha desu ga Nakama ni Muryokuka Sarete Osowaremashita

183569.description:
A shut-in girl is being taken care of by none other than her older brother. Her room is cluttered to no end, and because she refuses to take baths, he has to force her to take them! He's unable to turn down his younger sister's requests for him to wipe dry her spoiled body after... because her chubby body's tender flesh feels good to touch, no matter where!

(Source: FANZA, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Megastore Alpha 2015-10.

synonyms: Deka In Girl♥Hina-chan Dokidoki Debut Sen♪
デカ陰ガ～ル♥ 日菜ちゃんドキドキデビュー戦♪

title.native: デカ陰ガ～ル♥ 日菜ちゃん
前世が伝説の大魔女だった不遇聖女は皇帝陛下に溺愛されています
title.romaji: Zense ga Densetsu no Dai Majo Datta Fuguu Seijo wa Koutei Heika ni Dekiai Sareteimasu

synonyms: I'm the Older Brother of a Famous VTuber, But For Some Reason I Became Famous

title.native: 有名VTuberの兄だけど、何故か俺が有名になっていた
title.romaji: Yumei Vtuber no Ani Dakedo, Naze ka Ore ga Yumei ni Natteita

183573.description:
In her first life, she was the infamous and "talentless" villainess Beljeanne. In her second life, she lived to the ripe old age of 86 as a Japanese woman. Now, in her third life, she carries all of those memories with her. A little old lady at heart, 16-year-old Laviange does all she can to hide her true abilities and live a perfectly normal life!

(Source: Manga UP! Global)
synonyms: A Notorious Villainess Enjoying a Life of "Talentlessness and Incompetence" in Her Third Life

title.english: Notorious No More: The Villainess Enjoys Feigning Incompetence
title.native: 稀代の悪女、三度目の人生で【無才無能】を楽しむ
title.romaji: Kitai no Akujo, Sandome no Jinsei de [Musai Munou] wo Tanoshimu

183574.description:
Third Prince Theodulf has been banished to a wasteland known as the Land of Death because he didn't receive a gift from the Goddess. It's a barren land where the air is so noxious, nothing can grow there. Surviving there is impossible... or so everyone thought! As it turns out, Theodulf is a reincarnated being and has received a power known as "Auto-Craft" from the Goddess. Using this powerful gift to automatically create everything, the prince proceeds to turn the Land of Death into one brimming with life!!

(Source: K Manga)
synonyms: 追放された転生王子、『自動製作』スキルで領地を爆速で開拓し最強の村を作ってしまう　〜最強クラフトスキルで始める、楽々領地開拓スローライフ〜
Tsuihou Sareta Tensei Ouji, "Jidou Seisaku" Skill de Ryouchi wo Bakusoku de Kaitaku Shi Saikyou no Mura wo Tsukutte Shimau: Saikyou Craft Skill de Hajimeru, Rakuraku Ryouchi Kaitaku Slow Life

title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Tensei Ouji, "Auto Craft" Skill de Ryouchi wo Bakusoku de Kaitakushi Saikyou no Mura wo Tsukutte Shimau: Saikyou Crafting Skill de Hajimeru, Rakuraku Ryouchi Kaitaku Slow Life

title.romaji: Hazure Yuusha Datta Ore ga, Sekai Saikyou no Dungeon wo Tsukutte Shimattan da ga?

183576.description:
My girlfriend and I are at a stage where we're getting bored with our relationship... The only thing that can respark that... is another one...?

(Source: Toomics)

183577.description:
Hoshi Taichi is enjoying his university life. He is popular on campus and full of confidence, but in fact, things were different in high school...

One day, at a university social gathering, Taichi meets Tanaka Hanako, the woman who revolutionized his life. What on earth happened between Taichi and Hanako in high school? And what will Taichi do when they meet again after such a long time? A sci-fi slice of life drawn by Itagaki Paru, the creator of "BEASTARS" and "SANDA"!

title.native: ミス★ユニバースユニバース

183578.description:
Iijima Yasutaka, a dull and ordinary high school boy from Chiba Prefecture, is out walking during the night of a study camp, when he helps out his classmate Ema Kitaoka who had gotten into trouble. After that, Ema starts talking to Yasutaka, but only outside of school. At first, Yasutaka is perplex, because he doesn't even like Ema very much—.

An improbable coming-of-age love story between two opposites!

(Source: Takarajimasha, translated)
synonyms: I was supposed to never fall in love with you.

title.native: 君に恋をするなんて、ありえないはずだった
title.romaji: Kimi ni Koi wo Suru Nante, Arienai Hazu Datta

183579.description:
Sasamura is curious about a new transfer student, Ayano Otsuka, who has beautiful handwriting. Otsuka comes to Sasamura family's stationery store and tells him that she wants to send some letters, which is unusual these days. Sasamura wants to make friends with her, but Otsuka has a secret she can't tell anyone...

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

183580.description:
Cang Yu hid her female identity and lived as the second son of the Cang family. She wants to go to the capital to find her mother's family roots, but she is ambushed by her family into becoming a candidate for the princess's consort instead. This princess is said to be extremely beautiful but cursed to bring misfortune to her partner. You better stay away from her, if you want to live! Cang Yu wants to get away from the husband-choosing contest as soon as possible, but she didn't expect to discover the princess's shocking secret... It turns out that the "princess" is not a princess at all! And Cang Yu is having trouble keeping up her own disguise...!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Whose Identity Will Be Discovered First, Wild Fox or Gao Linghua?
偽り人生の恋愛ゲーム
周生如故:不知公主是夫郎

title.native: 野狐狸与高岭花谁会先掉马？
title.romaji: Ye Hu Li Yu Gao Ling Hua Shei Hui Xian Diao Ma?

title.native: 壊れていてもかまいません

183582.description:
In a world where alphas and omegas are the stuff of urban legends, Do-Ha is a rare dominant omega who usually deals with his heat cycle through casual one-night stands. One day, he uses a matching service and gets paired up with an alpha named Ji-Hwan. Things get unexpectedly intense. Overwhelmed by pheromones, Do-Ha forgets about precautions and ends up knotted, leaving him in shock. However, Ji-Hwan seems entirely unfazed by the situation and boldly suggests they meet again, saying, "Don't tell me you're scared because I'm an alpha..."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.
synonyms: นัดรักเซอร์วิสลับ

title.native: 坊ちゃま 搾精の時間です

183584.description:
Mare, an abandoned child, was picked up by a fox spirit, Nibi, and they started living together. As a youkai who dislikes humans, Nibi is worried about Mare going out on the town, so he gets overprotective. As she grows into adolescence, she becomes more rebellious and over-sensitive. A Japanese-style fantasy romance about two people who love each other even though they clash!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

183585.description:
Xiao Zhou, a fledgling photographer's assistant, felt captivated when she saw the model Lan Shan at a bar. Lan Shan doesn't get angry when she notices Xiao Zhou taking pictures of her surreptitiously, but instead, she is struck by the aura that comes out in the photos. They fall deeply in love at first sight, as their destinies become intertwined.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

183588.description:
1. (人妻リリナは神対応?～旦那以外にご奉仕します～)
2. (人妻ヒップトレイン?～巨尻アナリスト～)
3. (陰キャ男子と清楚女子!?～逆転不倫～)
4. (可愛すぎた、泣かしたい!)
5. (人妻ドリーマー)

title.native: 肉欲的人妻トランジション
寝取られ女将の濡れ艶おもてなし

183591.description:
Gi-Woo just needs a job, and almost any job will do…but he gets more than he bargains for when he stumbles into a position at Cha Seon-Jo’s Battle Cafe. Not only is the owner of this top-tier PC cafe so handsome it’s nearly criminal, he’s also hiding a secret that's actually criminal…

(Source: Lezhin US)

183592.description:
An anthology of horror stories. Please enjoy the “sensation” of everyday life going haywire.

(Source: Cycomi, translated)

title.native: メス堕ちテンカウント

183594.description: Published in Mushi Pro Shoji's “COM Comics” Feb. 1972 issue.

183596.description:
Weiss, witnesses an elf girl being sold into slavery. When he realizes that the girl is not just any elf, but a rare High Elf, he decides to buy her and raise her like a daughter.

Weiss finds himself raising a child for the first time. Thanks to his efforts, the girl, who was abused and unable to speak, regains her health. He decides to name her "Lily," after the first word she spoke.

Weiss, suddenly a parental figure, now has a new goal, to get Lily into the magic academy!

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)
synonyms: My daughter was an unsold slave elf.

title.native: 売れ残りの奴隷エルフを拾ったので、娘にすることにした
title.romaji: Urenokori no Dorei Elf wo Hirotta node, Musume ni Suru Koto ni Shita

183597.description: Jun and Naomi, the most fashionable and coolest female duo! From hunts to murders, “Siamese Cat” covers everything!

183598.description:
Enami confessed to his crush, Ritsu, but was turned down. Just as he thinks this love is over, he stumbles upon Ritsu's secret...?! A rom-com that perfectly captures the bittersweet struggles of youth!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

183599.description:
"Reincarnation takes place in an area simply known as "The Cage" a series of intertwined towers and dungeons, sometime in the far future. A girl awakens on a stone floor with no voice and no memories, and is greeted by a strange being calling itself Mama. In order to restore what she has lost and to redeem herself from a past sin, the girl and Mama travel to reawaken fragments of a forgotten world."

(Source: Square Enix, translated)
synonyms: ニーア リィンカーネーション
NieR Re[in]carnation: The Girl and the Monster

183600.description:
At the end of summer, Eiji Aono witnesses his childhood friend and girlfriend, Miyuki Amada, cheating on him with Kondo, the ace of the soccer team. When Eiji arrives at school after the vacation break, he is met with a barrage of unsavory rumors.

"He is a terrible person."
"He gets violent, too."

Kondo spread rumors that Eiji was a bad guy who had abused Miyuki. Eiji starts getting bullied at school, and it only gets worse day by day. One day, looking for escape, Eiji wandered up to the rooftop and saw Ichijo Ai, the most beautiful girl at school. Taking her hand, Eiji and Ai run away from school together.

A pure-love story about a young man who has to start over from the bottom of despair to makes a grand comeback!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

183601.description:
Drama club president Chigusa and vice president Azuma are always doing improvisational plays, so people tease them and ask if they are dating. Although Chigusa denies it in front of the club members, in reality she secretly has feelings for Azuma... After club activities, when she is alone with Azuma, Chigusa gathers up her courage and confesses her feelings, but Azuma mistakes it for an improvisational play! In order to properly convey her feelings to Azuma as he begins to act, she begins to offer his body to him.

(Source: Fanza, translated)

I was 16 at the time, and even though many of my memories are now wrapped up in the cloak of time, I can still clearly remember the feelings of that time.... Our heroine works at a lifestyle goods company and is the only person in her department who treats her lazy and socially awkward coworker Sakaki with any niceties. One night after a big work party, Sakaki takes her home and then he forces himself on her. Unable to get it out of her mind, she heads to work the next day. While working, a worried coworker touches her waist and Sakaki is having none of it. He goes over to the heroine's house after work, to have a talk. But no sooner than later are the two in bed with him tying her hands up.

183621.description:
Sano Masamichi, an unremarkable cram school teacher, decides to attend a signing event for his favorite novelist, Kotoba Mitsuru.

There, he unexpectedly encounters Mitsuharu Kotone, a student notorious for napping in his class. To his surprise, the genius bestselling author turns out to be none other than his own high school student! They had crossed paths once before, sharing dreams of becoming writers. However, Kotone, unable to accept that Masamichi has given up on his dream, takes an unexpected action:

“Write something for me. If you don’t want your life to end with just this photo…”

Using this leverage, Kotone draws Masamichi—who already has a girlfriend and a stable life—back into the world of writing.

“Return to your ordinary life, or become a novelist with me. What will it be?”

After struggling with his decision, Masamichi finally chooses to pursue his dream once more under Kotone’s guidance. Through this journey, he begins to realize that within his student’s eyes reflects an entirely different world...

(Source: Kodansha Lanove Bunko, translated)

183623.description:
I want to escape from my hectic daily life and travel! What if the most beautiful girl in school makes that dream come true?

A high school boy from Tokyo, Takahashi Shou, is fed up with his constricting daily life, and he decides to run away a journey. When he gets to the train station platform, he sees his classmate, Riho Nanase, also standing there, deep in thought. He asks her to come with him on the trip. She is skeptical at first, but eventually she begins to loosen up and enjoy the food and sights along the way.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Lorenzo, heir to the House of Medici, feels suffocated by the daily routine of a path that's already been carved out for him. But then one day, after coming across a girl who seems to be the embodiment of freedom, his ashen days begin to change color...? Set in 15th century Florence, Italy, a coming-of-age drama mixed with vibrant emotions begins!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

183627.description:
Ji-Han has spent a lifetime adhering to the rules in a bid to win the approval of his parents and peers. But he never receives true affection until he meets a boy by the name of Joon-Hyuk injured on the street. Against all expectations otherwise, Ji-Han takes Joon-Hyuk in as his roommate. But little does Ji-Han know that this chance encounter will change his entire life...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

183630.description:
Mitsuki is an ordinary thirty-something office worker leading a monotonous 9-to-5 life. His hum-drum routine is suddenly shattered when he tries to help a girl in distress, only to be unexpectedly transported to a different world. While the girl is meant to be there, Mitsuki is out of place, and nobody knows what to do with him. Fortunately, Volk, a striking and noble knight, takes it upon himself to care for Mitsuki–even gently tending to him after he’s rendered unconscious from an injury. But when Mitsuki comes to, it’s not Volk next to him but a large black wolf! Just who–or what–is Volk and how is Mitsuki expected to survive in this unfamiliar world?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

To protect the Tokugawa family, he traveled the country with swords of Chiko Muramasa, possessed by evil spirits.... Watching a porn video during class, hoping things might change if the situation were different, he was approached by Ren, a well-known playboy!! He said, "I jerk off to stuff like that a lot, too. I love it." When Yota opened up to him about his worries without realizing it, Ren started touching Yota, saying, "How about I beat you off?" 183635.description:
Rosalinde Baltzer was born as the only daughter of Baron Baltzer. Due to the former baron's gambling addiction which landed them with many debts, they were forced to live in poverty, and were only nobility in name. Nevertheless, she was raised by parents who were extremely humble and loving.

However, when she was 14, her parents passed away. After selling the only assets she possessed, which were her home and land, to pay the debts, she was left with nowhere to go. Thanks to her relative's recommendation, she was able to acquire a job as a gardener for the royal castle's back garden.

Rosalinde then decided to live quietly in the back garden, surrounded by her favorite plants. However...

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

183636.description:
Keith, a legendary con artist who made a career out of swindling mafias and criminal syndicates, finds himself cornered by the police. To avoid capture, he hides in the most unlikely place—prison. But the temporary safety of his self-imposed confinement is short-lived when he catches the attention of the prison's ruthless warden, Della, the most feared guard in the joint. Now, Keith must navigate a new power struggle where he might be forced to lose more than just his freedom.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: キャッシュ・オア・クレジット

183637.description:
While working the regular shift in a supermarket, Ailene finds herself waking up in the body of a nanny within a fantasy novel. Knowing this character dies at the hands of the twin princes at the beginning of the novel, Ailene vows to raise these boys to be kindhearted and avoid their dark storyline. She fits right into her role and things seem to be looking up until the empire’s “mad dog” Duke Kasar stumbles into her life and asks her to pretend to be his lover. Will Ailene make it through the fantasy novel alive?!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: I Didn't Sign Up to Be a Nanny!

183638.description:
To meet his dead parents again, Hong Bin made a deal with the Baseball Fairy, who agreed to return him to the past if he achieved 3,000 career hits as a baseball player. And at the age of 40, Bin the baseball legend hits his last ball and goes back in time. After reuniting with his family, Bin decides to pursue his old dream of joining the major league. The only issue is that he's lost all his old skills as a pro! But will his past experiences be enough to help this legend fulfill his new goal?

(Source: Tapas)

183639.description:
Kunieda Kei is the up-and-coming Prince Charming of the evening news, but inside, he’s anything but princely. He’s brash, hot-tempered, and prickly as can be. For years, he’s been able to juggle his private and professional personas, but a run-in with animator Ushio Tsuzuki threatens to bring that all crashing down. Will Kei’s mask slip and expose him for who he is, or is there someone who might love and accept both his sides?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

They’re best friends who can talk openly about almost anything—except one secret Hibiki keeps to himself: he has feelings for Chiaki! But when Hibiki accidentally drinks one of Chiaki’s mysterious inventions, his hidden emotions start to spill out in a completely unexpected way...!

(Source: Cmoa Comic, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183641.description:
Kagomiya Mikado, the noble son of the Kagomiya Group, is suddenly transported to another world, where he meets and falls in love with Abel, the leader of the Kingdom Knights. However, after an attack by the sorcerer Vernon, Mikado loses the power to return to his original world. Determined to find a way back, he sets out on a journey with Abel, discovering that the key lies with the elusive elves. Despite their struggles and setbacks, they hope to overcome the harsh journey by strengthening their love and bond. But as time goes on, Abel starts to change…

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

183662.description: Mochizuki Hanase had a bad test score in Japanese, and her teacher advised her to start writing a diary to help her learn to organize her thoughts and write better. She tried to write about the things she liked and did in her daily life. However, as she began writing, her head was filled with thoughts about her classmate Moa-Chan, making her embarrassed to write it down.

183663.description:
The gals in Ryuuji Aizawa's class treat him like he's not even there. Like this girl named Nana Aino, who likes to sit in his seat. With him still in it.

The original web comic titled Class no Gal ni Kuuki Atsukai Sareteimasu (クラスのギャルに空気扱いされています) that was released in 24 parts on Twitter and Pixiv has been compiled on Amazon into 1 ebook volume titled Aino Nana no Keikaku: Class no Gal ni Kuuki Atsukai Sareteimasu (愛乃ななの計画 クラスのギャルに空気扱いされています) and released on October 14, 2024.

183664.description:
Meet up-and-coming indie manga artist, Nekoyashiki Mamoru! He might have garnered a small, dedicated fanbase devoted to his gay comics and even scored a coveted seller's booth at the bi-annual Comic Kingdom event, but this paltry fame isn't enough! It's certainly not on the level of Kazama Issei, an actual idol and Mamoru's childhood friend. When a chance encounter throws them back into each other's orbit, things get complicated as the ever-cheerful Issei brings back messy childhood memories and inspires feelings of inferiority in Mamoru. Their paths crash together in this story about professional challenges, personal feelings, and...moobs? sense of purpose. Who knew that coding lessons could change so many lives?

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: 人氣同人作家貓屋敷想得到認同
Kabe Circle Doujin Sakka no Nekoyashiki-kun wa Shounin Yokkyuu wo Kojiraseteiru

title.english: All Eyes on Nekoyashiki-kun! Notice Me, Not My Characters
title.native: 壁サー同人作家の猫屋敷くんは承認欲求をこじらせている
title.romaji: Kabe Saa Doujin Sakka no Nekoyashiki-kun wa Shounin Yokkyuu wo Kojiraseteiru

183667.description:
Lacey has devoted her whole life to practicing magic in order to defeat the Demon King. Now that she's succeeded, it's time for an even tougher challenge—learning how to stand up for herself and live freely as a magical handywoman!

"Now that she's defeated the Demon King and become the country's greatest mage, Lacey has officially fulfilled her life's purpose. All that's left is to spend the rest of her days in a loveless political marriage. But when her engagement is broken off, Lacey realizes that all she wants is to live freely. Her wish is granted, and she moves into an empty mansion near a sleepy village.

Settling in is hard for her; shy and self-effacing, Lacey doesn't know anything about living on her own! She can fry legions of monsters, but frying up a meal? She'd rather starve. Luckily, her friends have her back; with the support of the community, her former party member Wayne, and a monster pet, Lacey slowly learns to take care of herself and come out of her shell.

Meanwhile, Lacey's worth becomes clear to the townspeople when she solves their problems with magic that's both unconventional and spectacular. So begins Lacey's newfound calling as a magical handywoman!"

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Lacey Longs for Freedom: The Dawn Witch's Low-Key Life after Defeating the Demon King
title.native: 暁の魔女レイシーは自由に生きたい ～魔王討伐を終えたので、のんびりお店を開きます～
title.romaji: Akatsuki no Majo Lacey wa Jiyuu ni Ikitai: Maou Toubatsu wo Oeta no de, Nonbiri wo Mise wo Hirakimasu

183668.description:
"Recently, I've been having the same nightmare every night."

Yashiro has been struggling with insomnia ever since starting his new job. The reason? His new boss, Isshiki, is an old classmate who once witnessed the most traumatic moment in his life. To cope with his sleepless nights, Yashiro turns to one-night stands whenever he can't sleep. But one night, when things take a turn for the worse, Isshiki unexpectedly comes to his rescue, and somehow, they end up sleeping beside each other?!

That night, Isshiki appears in Yashiro's dream as Yashiro's favorite character, the demon lord, Toma. Unlike the real Isshiki, this dream version is sweet, tender, and showers him with affection. Surprisingly, Yashiro wakes up feeling strangely refreshed... Could this be the cure for his insomnia?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ワンダーラブは真夜中に

183669.description:
University student Reo has been stalked ever since he accidentally bumped into Takuma, a seemingly simple guy he met for the first time during the incident. Reo is terrified that Takuma might be holding a grudge and plans to get back at him. One day, Takuma invites Reo to dinner, and he feels too scared to refuse. Desperate, Reo begs for his safety, but to his surprise, Takuma suddenly confesses that he’s in love with him! Takuma had fallen for Reo at first sight the day they collided. Reo is confused, but Takuma suggests they date for a limited time...!

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title.native: もうすぐ食われるかもしれん

183670.description:
A broken camera reveals memories we were never meant to know. Mochizuki, an Omega, works at a café and has fallen in love with Kitagawa, a regular customer who happens to be a Beta. Kitagawa is an excellent doctor—handsome, kind, and protective—especially when he shields Mochizuki from trouble. Mochizuki is captivated by Kitagawa, who seems perfect in every way. However, both are hiding secrets from each other: Kitagawa retains memories of a past life, and Mochizuki possesses a camera that reflects the past. Together, they are at the heart of a dramatic love story that spans time itself.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: includes one extra chapter.

title.native: マジックアワーの恋人たち

183671.description:
In the near future, research on male pregnancy is being conducted to combat population decline. Nagisa Fuyumi, forced into becoming a test subject despite not wanting to get pregnant, has lived at the institute for five years without ever going into heat. Trapped in the worst situation of his life, he unexpectedly reunites with his childhood friend, Hayato Hinoｓaki—a man he once admired but grew disillusioned with. Now, Hayato is both a test subject and a researcher at the institute. Their fates intertwine once again, but this time under very different circumstances...

(Source: J-publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Guinea Pig Don't Dream of Outside the Prison

title.native: ギニーピッグは檻の外の夢を見ない
title.romaji: Guinea Pig wa Ori no Soto no Yume wo Minai

183672.description:
Kurata is a talented editor with a string of successful projects under his belt. At a party, he finally gets the opportunity to approach best-selling author Enjouji Nao, whom he has admired for years, hoping to become Enjouji's new editor. However, Kurata is taken aback when he meets a strikingly handsome man who looks more like an actor than a writer. Despite Kurata's enthusiasm, Enjouji bluntly tells him that he has no intention of writing any more novels. The reason? Enjouji harbors a twisted tendency—after finishing a manuscript, he gets so sexually excited that he’s driven to attack anyone nearby...!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183673.description:
Thirteen-year-old Towa, suffering from a persistent "Chuunibyou" syndrome, is suddenly transported to another world. Although he is a rare foreigner in the new land, he has yet to manifest his "gift"—a unique ability granted only to outsiders. To hide the fact that he lacks this power, Towa puts on an arrogant front, earning the dislike of those around him, including Griz, his own guard knight. Depressed and disheartened, believing that even Griz, whom he considered his only ally, despises him, Towa is attacked from behind. When he wakes up, he finds himself back in his original world, but fifteen years have passed. Haunted by memories of Griz, he now lives as a simple businessman. Yet, for reasons unknown, Towa finds himself drawn back into the parallel world once again...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 嫌われ者の転移者は、出戻った異世界で溺愛される
title.romaji: Kirawaremono no Tenisha wa, Deatta Isekai de Dekiai sareru

183674.description:
Amamiya Sagiri, a popular high school student known for his good looks, athleticism, and personality, meets Himura Hagi in his new class at the start of the semester. The moment Sagiri sees Hagi, he’s reminded of a boy from middle school who was once crying, hidden in a corner of the school. Though Hagi denies being that boy, Sagiri can’t shake the image from his mind.
"I’m not good with people in tears. But back then, seeing him cry brought me a strange sense of relief..."

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183675.description:
Saeki is a handsome section chief who excels at his job and is well-liked, yet he’s single. Everything seems to be going perfectly, except for one problem: he can’t help but notice his male subordinate Fujikawa’s nipples! Always cheerful and smiling, Fujikawa’s nipples are visible through his shirt, and when they get damp with sweat, they become even more pronounced—making them hard for Saeki to ignore. But why is this happening? He’s neither gay nor does he have a nipple fetish! Fujikawa is a natural airhead, and when Saeki suggests he wear an undershirt, he completely misses the point. To make matters more complicated, they are scheduled for an overnight business trip together. Can Saeki resist the temptation of those distracting nipples?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183676.description:
Luna wakes up one day to realize that she has been reborn into a novel as the childhood friend of the male lead, Fersen. To make matters worse, the guy is a clueless idiot! Luna wants to end their friendship to escape being bullied by the other ladies, but Fersen won't leave her alone no matter what she does. Things only get more complicated when she becomes entangled with the novel's villain, who hates Fersen even more than she does. Will Luna manage to get away from this dumb male lead?

(Source: Tapas)

Section Chief Zaizen always has a smile on his face and is the object of everyone's admiration!! And on his days off, he's... A somewhat quirky, super lazy person!? A lazy comedy that will warm your heart!

(Source: Coamix, translated)

183696.description:
"To stay alive… I have no choice but to become a genius. I’ll do my best starting today, so please support me."

Lee Hyun-Woo finds himself possessing Kyle Seltarion, an extra character from a game where he used to reign as the world’s number-one player. Considering the game’s storyline, he soon faces the imminent death of Kyle, who, on top of being on death's door, can't use magic or aura and has a terrible reputation. How did he end up in the body of such a character?

However, after discovering a new talent, he learns to harness mana and begins to shift his attributes and reputation with knowledge of hidden routes gained through grinding in the game. His immediate goal is to save his own life, but that goal is closely linked to the impending global catastrophe... To overcome this situation, he needs to gather allies and boost his reputation!

It's time to turn his past, which was a reckless mess, around and move into a new phase!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Magic Genius of the Marquis House

183698.description:
Shunned as the weird kid at school, Han Siha wakes up one morning to find he is not quite himself anymore. Instead, a former vet intern who died from overworking has taken over Siha's body! But this story isn't like the novel he read in the "real world." With status windows popping up, feisty dragon partners, and classmates meant to be his future enemies, Siha is unsure if his skills are up to snuff. Will this mage make it to graduation? Or will he find that this story has an abrupt ending?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Genius Tamer of The Academy
アカデミーの天才テイマーになりました

183699.description: To Saki, Koiro has been her long-time friend since grade school, and someone she deeply admires. After having her nails painted by Koiro to match her, she returns home and thinks back...

183700.description:
Tomohisa Sasaki is a 41-year-old CEO whose dogged efforts have earned him an appearance much younger than his age. However, he has very little experience with women, and he suffers from an inability to perform in bed. Hoping to reclaim his troubled youth, he visits nightclubs and pays for hostesses to keep him company. One night, while having dinner with his favorite hostess, a dark-haired and handsome young man named Shota barges in and gets into a heated argument with Tomohisa's companion. To Tomohisa's surprise, Shota turns out to be friendlier than he looks, and the two hit it off despite their age difference.

A late-blooming middle-aged man finds love for the first time with a young grad student who comes on strong!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183701.description:
It’s the season of cherry blossoms dancing in the breeze. Hanashi Nao, who had passed the university of his choice with flying colors and is now a freshman, isn’t exactly feeling thrilled. Mumbling to himself about needing a part-time job, he is suddenly approached by a man. The man, Uryu Mashio, tells Nao he’s recruiting for a video production club that offers a daily allowance, despite being just a club. It seemed too good to be true in this day and age, but Nao, easily persuaded, agrees. Mashio, a year older than Nao, dreams of becoming an adult film director. However, his skills are questionable—he fumbles with his phone, his movements awkward and restless, showing no signs of talent. He seems like a total clunker! And yet, the content of the video—just something simple like kneading water—somehow captivates Nao, who can’t seem to take his eyes off the phone screen showing Mashio’s work...

(Source: Eiwa Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Are you aware of your attractiveness?

title.native: どんな表情してるか知ってんの？
title.romaji: Donna Kao Shiteru ka Shitten no?

183702.description:
Tamaki, a high school boy, is reunited with Azuma, the person he had a crush on during junior high. As they reconnect, the once-distant Azuma gradually grows closer to him. Though Tamaki longs to stay by Azuma’s side, his deep-seated inferiority complex begins to take over, making it harder for him to control his emotions...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: The chapter count includes extras.

title.native: キスだけじゃガマンできない

183703.description:
Tsubakiyama Academy, a boarding school equipped with technology that blocks pheromone detection, serves as the only “safe zone” in a society where birthright dictates status. Hatanaka Sho, a popular student with good looks and excellent grades, has led a smooth sailing life, with everyone assuming he’s an Alpha. However, Sho recently discovered he is actually an Omega due to a developmental birth defect. Shocked by the news, Sho tries to process the revelation. On his way home, he has a brief encounter with a stranger, sparking an unsettling feeling. Sho returns to school, only to find that the next day, the man has transferred in and boldly declares, “I’m here to find my fate!”

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 隠れΩの俺ですが 、執着αに絆されそうです
title.romaji: Kakure Ω desu ga, Shuuchaku α ni Kizuna Saresou desu

183704.description:
Software engineer Chiaki Yanagishima is dating the owner of the club "Butterfly Kiss", Masatsugu Shibanushi. Known as "Osho" or "King", Masatsugu is constantly surrounded by women. As he continues his relationships with numerous other women, Chiaki's heart and body begin to wear thin. Every time he tries to complain, Masatsugu takes him roughly, and Chiaki just can't refuse... However, when talk of a transfer comes his way, Chiaki finally decides to break things off with Masatsugu... but will he let him?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Butterfly Bone on Your Lips ~Butterfly Rouge~
title.native: くちびるに蝶の骨〜バタフライ・ルージュ〜
title.romaji: Kuchibiru ni Chou no Hone: Butterfly Rouge

183705.description:
Summoned into a world where the divine and martial arts coexisted, Qiao Mu can revive infinitely while leveling up. The more tragic his death, the stronger he gets when he revives. His enemies are shocked when they realize after defeating a boy, another man up, without end! Rumors started to spread about the legendary Qiao family… Wait, no one told me that every revival makes me older!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Kill Me a Few More Times and I Will Be Invincible
The More I Die, The More Invincible I Become

183706.description: Sisters Miyuko and Hinako used to be very close to each other. After a certain incident, Miyuko distanced herself from Hinako who wears Lolita fashion in public. Then one day, Miyuko finds her sister's Lolita clothing in her room...

183707.description: Fugo, a rookie exorcist, burns with hatred for the demon who destroyed his family. His master, concerned about Fugo's obsession with revenge, urges him to speak with a certain demon. This demon is "Ilya." As Fugo engages in repeated conversations with her, gradually, he has a change of heart...

183708.description: One day, an application to be a model for a beauty portrait arrives. A shocking truth is revealed when old friends reunite for the first time in many years.

183709.description:
Rixie is a succubus often masquerading as a service provider who visits homes, whether it to be checking the gas valves, the water pipes, or the internet connection. But that’s just a front for her to find humans to feed on. One day, she finds the perfect prey: Puhr, a boy who seems rich both financially and in energy to devour. Unfortunately, she has no idea who the predator really is until Puhr shows his true colors…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 定期点検に参りました！

Newly arrived at the Cornfield Orphanage is Noah, a survivor of the Vanta clan who has special dark powers. Together with his fluffy best friend, Chappy, he aims for a peaceful and fun orphanage life while battling evil entities that are after his power!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

183713.description: Marie is a robot developed by Kei, a prosthetic researcher. Equipped with a program that gives her emotions of love called the “Romance Code”, Marie supports Kei as her lover, but as she becomes busier and busier, she begins to experience painful unknown feelings....

183715.description:
The Mystic Frontier is a region where humans and monsters coexist in the sense that they share the common principle of "survival of the fittest." In this land filled with strife, the young hero Lucciola Lunatria wields her silver claws in the hopes of delivering the land from monsters to usher in peace—at least, until she meets Bilqis Draco, a first-rate merchant of Mystic Frontier Trading Co.. Through their meeting, Lucciola learns that violence isn't the only solution to the answer she seeks, opening her eyes to a whole new world of possibilities in brokering an age of harmony to the frontier!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

183716.description:
Nan Mo is the top boudoir photographer in the country. She has photographed all sorts of celebrities and stars, but Jiang Yudai is the only one she dreams about late at night. Jiang Yudai was only 18 years old when she became a award-winning actress, and she is still a superstar ten years later, with her irresistibly seductive looks and intimidating beauty. No one knows that she actually lurks online, leaving all sorts of crazed fangirl comments on Nan Mo's SNS accounts, hoping that Nan Mo will cover every inch of her body with her camera some day.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

183717.description:
25-year-old Kuzayama Hiroshi could no longer endure the workplace abuse and the harsh words of his superiors. Unable to cope, he quit his job and became a homebody. However, one day, a beautiful woman named Takahashi Ai appeared, claiming to represent the Tokyo Metropolitan Government. She offered him a chance to join the [Youth Rehab Project]. If he accepted, the government would provide him with financial support, his type of girl, and mental support…

I had sex with my own daughter - in a dream, of course.

Goto, a university lecturer, had a happy family, with a beautiful artist wife, and smart, cute children… However, this happiness was only a shell. Goto suspects his wife's infidelity by day, and he is plagued by nightmares at night, as his sanity is fraying. One day, Goto came home to find his daughter in tears in her room, which had been vandalized. Convinced that it was his wife, Goto is determined to protect his precious daughter…! An immoral family thriller!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Hoshine, the elite young lady of the Tendou family, has long harbored feelings for Eito, the servant who has been by her side since childhood. When she discovers that a classmate has confessed to Eito, Hoshine doesn’t hesitate! She decides to pour all of her intellect, strength, wealth, and (questionable) intuition into winning his heart. See the surprising lengths she will go for love in this chaotic lady-and-butler rom-com!

The series revolves around four strangers who saved the life of a 10-year-old girl who jumped from the platform of a train. Years later, Kasumi Kado, a 28-year-old office worker who was among the four strangers, encounters the now-17-year-old girl again. The four strangers must reunite to save the girl once again.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Lee Woogeon, the Vice Chairman of Korea Electronics, is a man consumed by his demanding career. However, at his grandfather's request, he agrees to meet an important person. To his shock, the person awaiting him is Yeon Rieul, a 22-year-old woman who is set to become his wife. With no belief in love, How will Woogeon handle the trials of marriage with such a young wife?

Suhwa's family is in crisis due to her husband's misfortune. While Suhwa's future looks bleak due to the mountain of debt that has fallen on her, the twins Sowon and Leewon who live next door propose a contract. In exchange for paying off the debt, she will work as their housekeeper. However, Suhwa is troubled by the contract as it requires her body rather than being an ordinary housekeeper, but she decides to accept the twins' contract anyway in order to protect her young son. Although she is a married woman with a child, she gradually becomes accustomed to and familiarizes herself with the twins...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

"Did you think all girls on the street fuck for money?" Former classmates of mine who I met again have grown up to be... hookers?! - "Tachinbo" are girls who serve you in exchange for money. Today, there are many "Tachinbo girls" waiting for men in front of a certain city park... Mitsuhide, a college student passing by, notices something strange as he walks past them. He wonders, "Wait... Don't I know these girls?" The girls on the street are his former classmates?! Mitsuhide somehow restrains his overwhelming instinct to do whatever he wants with them for money, but then... "You really want my body, don't you?" One calls to him. 183731.description:
Koh Yoo possesses the unique ability to see memories from the last whenever he smells something linked to them. However, this gift comes with a dangerous flaw: whenever Yoo is drawn into these memories, his consciousness leaves his body in a dazed and defenseless state. One day, he narrowly avoids getting hit by a car thanks to Lee Yoohan, who jumps in to save him. To Yoo’s surprise, he discovers that when Yoohan is near, he can see scents as physical forms, allowing him to avoid being pulled into memories. As the two grow closer, Yoo begins to navigate his abilities with Yoohan's unexpected help, but lingering questions about their connection remain.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The school nurse, Yoshito, has a secret plan to correct problem students through "counseling." It involves controlling their minds with a hypnotic drug. Students who are given this drug are rehabilitated, but girls may become his sex toys... Meanwhile, the principal gives him instructions to deal with Erina, the most delinquent high school girl at the school. Together with his assistant and servant, Seika, Yoshito tricks her into putting her under hypnosis, and then he plays with her body at will, destroying her dignity.

This time, his target, the Hidaka family, is a "priceless customer" with a beautiful mother and two high school daughters. He sneaks past the eyes of the troublesome men who have followed him, and threatens them to get them. To carry out his plan, he also calls in his despicable younger brother and his younger brother's girlfriend to help him. And so begins the fun of a hellish vacation.

(Source: Parabook, translated and edited)

Former judo star Joo Ha-Na marries her friend, Do Woo-Ri, and stages an insurance fraud so they can leave the country as a rich couple. Everything goes according to plan, including Woo-Ri's disappearance, and Ha-Na finally receives the money five years later. But when she goes to meet her husband, she comes face to face with his corpse instead. As Ha-Na tries to figure out what's happening, she gets a letter... from her dead man. With this new clue, can she unravel the mystery of his death?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes Prologue.

183750.description:
Ten people gather in front of ten candles over the course of ten days. Each day, they take turns telling scary stories in front of their candle. What happens once the storyteller finishes their turn and the candlelight goes out?

183751.description:
Murder is in the air, a mystery's trail is marked with feathers and it's quickly running cold. Cheol-Min Han is an office worker who suspects that he's losing his mind...or is he seeing the truth for the very first time? Who are these bird-faced, bloodthirsty creatures he's confronted with? Why are they hunting him? Where do they come from? What do they want? Who will believe him? Most importantly, how will he survive?

(Source: Tapas)

Oh San-Ho is a popular novelist on the internet, but in reality, he is a loner! He wants to be recognized in real life as much as he is on the internet, but it is not easy, and his skills, popularity, and unrequited love are all miserable in reality. Oh San-Ho writes a novel using Baek Seol-Ah, a popular girl he has always admired, as a model, and Baek Seol-Ah discovers the novel. At the moment when she is so desperate that she thinks about committing suicide, she says, "Thank you for writing with me as a model." After losing his house and job, Uno has to shoulder his runaway ex-wife's debt and star in a gay porn! Down in despair after his life fell apart right before his eyes, he is saved by his former close friend, Iwakura. When Yukiji is approached by his coworker and best friend, Kaname, with concerns about being stalked, he's ready to jump to his friend's aid. But as Kaname details the stalking incidents, Yukiji is shocked to realize that Kaname's "stalker" is none other than Yukiji and his anonymous gestures of care. Fearing he might ruin their friendship, Yukiji wrestles with the dilemma of coming clean. In fear of another visit from the stalker, Kaname asks Yukiji to stay over for the night, and he reluctantly agrees. But the night takes an unexpected turn when Yukiji awakens to find his own hand grabbing Kaname's crotch! Despite Yukiji's panic, Kaname closes in with an unknown intent…

When a cunning and obsessive stud latches onto an incredibly square and clueless dork, a rom-com full of hilarious misunderstandings begins!

183759.description:
Omega Haru wakes up in an oasis in the desert only to see a beastman appear in front of him. He feels his whole body tremble, and he has no memory of who he is or even his own name. Viano, the alpha leader of the black panther tribe and the one who summoned Haru, speaks gently, telling him he is in a world ruled by beastmen, and that the two of them are destined mates. As Haru learns more about this new world and spends his days with Viano, he feels an irresistible passion well up inside him. However, Haru, who cannot conceive Viano's child no matter how much he wants to, finds himself in a dangerous situation... and remembers. The memories of his former world and the meaning of losing those memories...

(Source: Renta!)

A young man is walking through an empty town at night when all the bars he frequents close early, and he is lured by a beautiful, half-naked woman standing in the street, Mako, into a strange restaurant called Walpurgis.

Since that moment, Rio has found himself lost in dirty fantasies about Hasumi every night. As he continues to see him each morning on the crowded train, his heart races with growing affection...

183767.description: Yukumina is from a merchant family, and as such travels the world to trade, together with his assistant Gvido. Except, Yukumina cannot use any magic whatsoever, even the most mundane variety that's a given in his trade, and Gvido is an incubus, magic folk, widely seen as little better than the animals and monsters that populate the wild forests. What kind of life will they manage to build together, when the world sees both of them as lacking...?

183768.description:
"Is my adorable little nephew the reincarnation of the demon king Lucifer?!"

Chris, a picture book author, takes in his nephew after the loss of his brother and sister-in-law during an accident. Noah is a strange and eccentric child with the ability to communicate with animals. One morning, overwhelmed with his new parental situation, Noah jumps into the road?! However, the person who saved Noah before it was too late was Harvey-sensei, the nursery school teacher, a demon with black wings and horns!! Revealing his true identity, the demon kneels down saying, “I have come to take you back, Lucifer-sama.”, announcing that Noah is the reincarnation of the demon king?!

Swimming is defined as the art of moving through water using one’s limbs. Yet sometimes, no matter how hard one fights to keep going, they find themselves adrift in a vast ocean; isolated, with no home - and no one - to turn to. This is the story of two men who swim against the currents to reach each other. But as the two dive deeper into the waters of love, will they be swept away by the everpresent tides of change?

(Source: Lezhin US)

183771.description:
For years, Wellmy Ernest has made her half-sister Iora's life a living nightmare. She forced Iora to obscure her beauty, treated her like a servant, and even stole her fiancé. Their own father and his second wife joined in on the torment, cruelly confiscating Iora's belongings and forcing her to live in a cold, drab detached building. Now that Iora has turned eighteen, Wellmy is ready for the final insult: marrying her off to Aides Ormirage, the handsome yet heartless mage lord.

Tonight, at last, her brilliant scheme will reach its climax at the banquet held by Aides himself. Yet as the villainess prepares for her final act, she is acutely aware that all that awaits her is her own doom.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

183788.description:
Freshman Ji Yulmu looks like the ultimate bookworm: thick glasses, baggy clothes, and a quiet, studious vibe. But inside her little green notebook? Nothing but filthy fantasies and kinky stories she’d never dare say out loud. That is, until her campus crush, upperclassman Jeong Wook, finds it. Instead of judging her, he’s thrilled, and he wants to “talk” about her writing. Now Yulmu is getting dragged into Wook’s mysterious X-Games club, where nothing is as innocent as it looks… and everyone, from Cha Ji-un to Seon Inhyeok, wants to play.

(Source: Lezhin US)
