Don't miss the signs given off by a bitch in heat... ❤

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2023-12.

183794.description:
Hell? Far from it. After all, isn't this what you wanted? After choosing to end his own life, Hui-Seo Yun awakens adrift on a wooden raft in a bleak, desolate ocean. Attacked by a monstrous creature that defies reality, he questions if it's a dream... but his instincts scream otherwise. Just when all seems lost, he is rescued by a mysterious woman who resembles a grim reaper. As he catches his breath, Hui-Seo asks: am I in hell?

(Source: WEBTOON)

183796.description:
“Healed Zombies,” those with rotting bodies but sound minds, are desperate for living humans; not just to kill but to receive transplants of their healthy body parts and survive! Fragmented spirits, fragmented bodies, and fragmented humanity... this is the desperate survival of broken people, left only with pieces of humans!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183801.description:
Following the guidance of a mysterious book, Holo and Lawrence suddenly find themselves in modern-day Japan. As they wander the unfamiliar streets, something catches Holo's nose: the tantalizing scent of delicious food! The gourmand Holo quickly becomes obsessed with all kinds of never-before-seen delicacies… Read on and even try some for yourself, with an included series of mouthwatering recipes straight from the world of Spice & Wolf!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Spice and Wolf Restaurant: Gourmet Exploration

title.english: Spice and Wolf Diner: Gourmet Exploration

183802.description:
It has been more than ten years since Holo and Lawrence, who became a happily married couple after completing their long journey to send the Wisewolf back home, opened the bathhouse Spice and Wolf in the hot spring resort of Nyohhira. This is a story of continued happiness spun in the bathhouse, which is said to bring happiness and laughter.

Note: All chapters were split into two parts during the original serialization.

183803.description:
This pleasure...is out of this world! ❤

Note: Published in COMIC BAVEL 2023-05.

183812.description:
Mabuto Sagoriya just wants to live a quiet life at school, but she's also competitive by nature. Her friend, Minoda-chan, asks her to represent their class in the competition for the right to use the rooftop at the school festival, known as the “Fugen Game." She gets caught up in a series of unusual challenges…? Deception and logic lead to victory - the ultimate battle of wits where no one dies!

(Source: Young Animal, translated)

183813.description:
In order to save her ill father, Yoo Yeon-Woo makes a dangerous deal to deceive the members of the esteemed Tae-Seong Group. Her task is to pretend to be her estranged twin sister, who disappeared just before her marriage to Tae-Seong’s youngest son, Cha Ki-Tae. Yeon-Woo only needs to keep up the act for six months, but in the fifth month, she is found out at the worst time possible: right after refusing to get intimate with her sister’s man. When asked for forgiveness, Ki-Tae offers her a simple solution.

“Just make it up to me with your body, Yeon-Woo.”

(Source: Tappytoon)

183814.description:
A once-glorious life ends in betrayal, and a desperate wish is granted. Waking up in the present, Song Si-Woo finds himself thrust into an unfamiliar world seemingly filled with echoes of his past. Whilst he soon discovers that fate still binds him to old friends, bitter enemies, and a beloved lover, nothing is as it seems—especially when reincarnation plays tricks with gender! Can he navigate these renewed connections and unravel the mysteries of his twice upon a time...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

183815.description:
After a long war, Lycoris, a princess of the Wyvern Kingdom, and Raika, a princess of the Dragon Kingdom, are to be married as a sign of peace. Former enemies, the two begin a new life together…

Lycoris has complicated feelings about the political marriage, but she can't help becoming attracted to Raika, who seems so lonely, despite her outward indifference.

Two girls who do not know how to love, bond with each other as they heal each other's broken hearts.

(Source: Shiori-on, translated)

183816.description:
The manga centers on Tatsuki Houshou, a female office worker, admired inside and outside the office as a popular and beautiful woman who is good at her job, but is very clueless when it comes to love. So clueless, that she does not even notice when a man makes advances toward her. Despite this, she still wants to understand love, and a person who makes her heart flutter appears before her.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title.romaji: Ki no Mi Ki no Mama

183817.description:
Jun, a good-looking tomboy, is a popular figure at her all-girls' school. She tries to always act in a stylish and gentlemanly manner to maintain her reputation, but when she gets into trouble, the “true handsome girl,” Makoto-senpai, is there to save the day…?

A short romantic comedy between two handsome girls!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I can't be cool in front of Makoto senpai

183818.description:
A strong, smart, and cool female investigator is accompanied by her junior colleague during a sting. Unfortunately, because of him, the two are found out, and the criminals have some ideas on how to punish her…

(Source: Irodori Comics)

183829.description:
I'm picking up trash.

My imaginary wife says, "You've started doing something strange again."

I reply, "Yeah, but it's fun."

(Source: Amazon, translated)

183830.description:
Aoba, a college student passionate about video games and live streams, heads to an empty classroom between lectures. He’s drawn in by the familiar voice of his favorite video game distributor, DOGS: Husky. When he opens the door, he finds Shigure Omoto, a quiet student known for never speaking in class. To Aoba’s surprise, Shigure, who seems to have a secret, threatens him to keep quiet about his identity as Husky. Caught off guard, Aoba realizes that he’s stumbled upon a significant secret that could change everything for both of them...

(Source: Ohzora Shuppan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Kimi no Koe ga Todoku made

183831.description:
Yamashita, a diligent office worker, is initially unhappy with his new boss, Touno. Although Touno is a soft-spoken and capable general manager, Yamashita feels an inexplicable discomfort around him. However, as they collaborate on an important project, they begin to grow closer. Just as Yamashita starts to let his guard down, Touno's strong presence awakens his inner “Sub.” Caught in a whirlwind of emotions, Yamashita experiences a kiss that leaves him breathless, his body melting under Touno's powerful “Dom” commands. As Touno explores what makes Yamashita feel good, he gently spoils him, awakening a deep longing that Yamashita can no longer resist. In the throes of pleasure, feelings bloom between them, leaving Yamashita yearning for more...

(Source: Overlap, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 躾けて甘やかして可愛がって

183832.description:
A one-night mistake brings Yesol to the doorstep of Hanrim, a cold yet familiar face from his high school baseball team. Only now, Hanrim isn’t just cold—he’s holding a grudge. What exactly happened between them, and why can’t Yesol remember?

(Source: Manta)

183833.description: A story about a ghost and the exhausted office worker he watches over as he gradually learns to find meaning in his life.
synonyms: The Ghost and the Exhausted Office Worker

183834.description: An omnibus of horror stories that explores relatable, everyday fears experienced in the contemporary Reiwa era. Each story in the series reflects modern anxieties, focusing on the fears lurking within daily life, which continue to escalate.
synonyms: Furcht: Horrorgeschichten aus dem modernen Japan

183835.description:
Arata is a new employee at a beauty salon when Rentaro, a former track and field junior, suddenly appears in his life again. Rentaro, now a promising college sprinter, has grown up since they last met four years ago. However, he's currently taking a break from running due to an injury. Unwilling to return home, Rentaro ends up staying with Arata temporarily. Years ago, Arata realized his feelings for Rentaro were more than friendship and left his hometown, unable to face the emotions Rentaro unknowingly stirred in him. Now, working as a make-up artist, Arata thought he had come to terms with those feelings by working on himself. But this unexpected reunion throws his emotions into chaos once again...

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183836.description:
A remake of the 1982 Mugen Shinshi Kaiki-hen.

Note: In the afterword to Shin Kaiki-hen, it was stated that Shin Kaiki-hen is a sequel to this and a seperate story like Ouma-hen and its sequels. Due to that note, this version of Mamiya is considered to be either a brand new "Seinen tantei D" or another version of "Seinen tantei C."

183837.description: A sequel to the remake of Mugen Shinshi Kaiki-hen.

183838.description:
Mashiro Naomoto wants to have a taste of romance and maybe go a little further than that, now that she's in high school.

However, she lacks self-confidence and she figured that it's impossible for anyone to like her. But to her surprise, a handsome boy named Oosagi-kun suddenly confesses to her. Mashiro suspects that his confession must be the result of some punishment game, but her own desires overcome her doubts, and she does the unexpected by making her own moves on him?!

This is a rom-com where a high school girl's libido runs wild!!

(Source: Comic-Meteor, translated)

183839.description:
"I just want you to hold me, even if you're drunk... You don't have to say 'I love you'."

Igarashi, who works as a photographer, has a sex-friend relationship with the popular stylist, Shida, who only fucks him when he's drunk. The truth is, he's had an unrequited love for Shida ever since they were classmates in high school, but he'd rather just have the memories of holding him in his arms than confess his true feelings and be rejected. But Shida keeps whispering things like "I love you" and "You're so cute" in a casual tone...?

(Source: Arca Comics, translated)

You can't help but get your hands dirty, too. If you read this book, you are welcome to masturbate together with these girls!

183841.description:
Lin Fan was transported to another world, into the body of an ordinary disciple. As a vulnerable victim, he was just trying to survive, until he suddenly gained an immortal body… Funny, it seems like he's now totally invincible.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

183842.description:
Mu-Hyeok Kim, grandson of the legendary "Loan Shark King," has done all of the family's dirty work for 30 years, only to be betrayed and killed by his uncle's orders. Mysteriously, he wakes up in 1990, in his first year of high school, just in time to save his grandmother on his father's side from a heart attack. Now in need of money to pay for her hospital bills, Mu-Hyeok goes to his mother's family to ingratiate himself with the Loan Shark King, but this time, he plans to take his money and get revenge.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: หลานอัจฉริยะของราชาเงินกู้

title.english: Genius Grandson of the Loan Shark King

183843.description:
High school boy Iriya Takeru is enjoying living on his own, as the fourth son of a prominent family...

"What am I going do?"

Due to her parents' circumstances, his fiancee ends up moving in to live with him!

"I can cook and improve your diet."
"I'll also take care of the cleaning."
"Isn't it more convenient with two people?"

Takeru thought his fiancee, Amamiya-san, would be a sheltered young lady, but she turns out to be "willing to do anything" to take care of him. At school, she is revered as the perfect young lady, but at home, she is a devoted doting partner. A youthful romantic comedy between a self-indulgent young man and a caring young lady, living together as a frustrating duo.

(Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)
183843.hashtag: #現実離れした美少女転校生

183844.description:
Senior and junior, best buddies, childhood acquaintances... some girls are more than just friends.
Most of them are not sure what to call this special feeling.

"Is this love?"

Some become couples, and others don't. This is a series featuring many types of girls, with four chapters for each episode. Please find your favorite!

The first episode is about Ryoka, who works part-time at a cafe dressed like a boy, and her junior, Rima, who falls in love with her at work. Ryoko thought of Rima as a troublemaker at school, but then she realizes that… "Why am I thinking about her all the time?"

183846.description:
Forced to obey her father every minute of her life, Baek Ara had no choice but to live as a prim and proper lady. To get back at her oppressive father, Ara decides to enjoy herself at a club... until she's found by Namgoong Yoon, her gentle first love, who coldly introduces himself as Ara's new bodyguard. Shaken by Yoon's coldness, Ara returns home, only to be met with the more shocking news of her imminent marriage. With time running out, can Ara win Yoon over before it's too late?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: Try Me Until You Choose Me as Your Real Girlfriend

title.native: 本物のカノジョにしたくなるまで、私で試していいよ。
title.romaji: Honmono no Kanojo ni Shitaku Naru made, Watashi de Tameshite Ii yo.

183848.description:
Meet Ido Noh, a shy first-year high school student with a severe stutter that makes talking to people nearly impossible. Her life changes when she meets Se-i Ryu, a robot with a mysterious past and a quest to reclaim his lost memories. Can Ido find her voice with this unlikely friend, and will Se-i uncover the secrets of his origin?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

In the forest, the young girl met a cheerful demon with a candle head.

"Why are you alone? Why are you so filthy?" "...Your flames are pretty."

"Eh? I like you. Form a contract with me."

What awaited the girl was a warm meal and a soft bed-?!
The crazy demon, Candle, and the mysterious girl, Little Mum, begin their strange life together.

Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter and pixiv accounts, it was collected for commercial publication by Kadokawa on September 19, 2024.

183853.description:
It's not cheating if it's sex practice! Just make sure you don't enjoy it too much, and use techniques like "finger-sucking" and "just the tip" to avoid getting too close to the real thing. But if you slip up and accidentally let your friend's boyfriend pour his cum in you, that's okay. It's only practice.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.romaji: Ecchi no Renshu wa Uwaki ja Nai yo ne?

183855.description:
Theo Ragnar, the 31st son of the mighty Grand Duke of Ragnar, was born without the legendary Ragnar Gift—a fatal flaw in a family where might is right. Labeled the “Ragnar Defect,” he and his mother were betrayed, meeting a brutal end at the hands of those they trusted. But death was only the beginning. Reborn at 17, Theo awakens not only with the Ragnar Gift, but with powers far beyond imagination. Fueled by vengeance and a second chance, he sets out to claim the glory he was once denied.

(Source: Tapas)

ラグナール～回帰の剣士～
El bastardo regresado del Clan de la Espada
บุตรอัปยศแห่งตระกูลนักดาบ

183857.description:
After moving to Neulbom Garden, the only inheritance of her husband, So-Hee begins to have nightmares. She discovers a photo of a mysterious female student in the mansion, and after that, the people she meets lose their lives one after another and become suspects in murder cases. What kind of case will So-Hee have to solve in Neulbom Garden?

(Source: Naver, translated)

183858.description:
One day, a self-destructive organ is created in the brains of teenagers. A life-threatening negotiation begins with adults who do nothing to save the dying children.

(Source: Naver, translated)

183859.description:
One day, Tama, a lazy man, receives a message from his friend Renafalt, whom he had met on the Internet for five years, but never seen in person. The message asked him, “Senpai, would you like to hire a home security guard?"

Tama, who was convinced that “Renafalt is 200% a man,” found a person with a red suitcase at the arranged meeting place. However, the person turns out to be a beautiful girl with big breasts.

"Ah...um...are you my senpai?"

The start of a strange cohabitation story between an apathetic man who wants to live quietly in his corner of the world, and a JK with a comical disorder!

(Source: Comic Ride, translated)
synonyms: Senpai, Will You Hire Me As a Housemaid?

title.romaji: Senpai, Jitaku Keibiin no Koyou wa Ikaga desu ka?

title.native: 仕事の後は抱きしめて

183863.description:
When Noah, a struggling web novelist, finds himself in an unexpected marriage with Jane, one of three sisters who once tormented him, his life takes a chaotic turn. As Jane is sent overseas for work, her empty home becomes a playground for her two sisters— Lisa, a sultry divorcee, and Emily, a bold college student. The odd cohabitation stirs unexpected emotions as Noah is torn between Jane’s provocative allure and Emily’s carefree spirit. As old feelings resurface and new temptations arise, Noah is caught in a tangled web of desire, guilt, and forbidden attraction. Will he find clarity amidst the chaos, or will he be forever trapped between the two sisters?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

183865.description:
“Miss Shin, please work your night shift at my house from now on.”

The workaholic vice president Jehu asks his secretary Yu-Na Shin four days after their company bans the night shift. Just like that, the two of them begin working together at night, but it doesn’t take long before their attention turns toward each other instead of work.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.native: とろ蜜満淫アパート 隣人は女子大生・OL・未亡人

183871.description:
He has the Doomsday Salvation System, which grants him rewards for saving the world from apocalyptic disasters. To do that, he recruits top talents to form a team known as the Guardians of Humanity. He jumps into post-apocalyptic worlds as the final defender of human civilization, as the entire world admires and worships him as a god. Massive natural disasters, waves of genetic mutations, the murmurs of eldritch horrors. No matter the challenge, the massive organization he has built will come to the rescue of humanity in each post-apocalyptic world.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Da Zao Le Jiushi Zuzhi

183872.description:
Nagi Shinonome, known as the “Ice Princess,” is a beautiful girl with a cold attitude who does not get along with other people. One day, Souta Minori notices her being molested on the train and musters up the courage to step in and save her. The next day she comes up to him again and asks him...

"I want you to stay by my side."

Can Sota continue to be "just friends” with the "Ice Princess," who melts sweetly only for him?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

When Arata winds up in the modern world and switches places with a boy named Arata Hinohara, it's a wonder which Arata's actually better off...

Hinohara is the spitting image of Arata, so he suddenly finds himself fighting people after his life! As he navigates through this foreign world filled with power-hungry warriors, who will come to his aid? One thing's for sure--it's not easy being Arata!

(Source: VIZ Media)

Lonely, awkward Giovanni has a sick mother, an absent father and an afterschool job that keeps him from playing with his classmates. One evening, on the night of the Star Festival, he is magically transported by train through the galaxy with his best friend, Campanella.The boys share a fantastical journey to the stars, meeting mysterious characters who prompt them to think about the meaning of life. Only when Giovanni returns to earth does he learn the heartbreaking truth about their adventure.

(Source: Tuttle Publishing)
synonyms: A Night on the Galactic Railway

183935.description:
Ichiyou has been in love with his childhood friend, the novelist Shiro, for over 10 years. Although they started living together when Shiro went to college, there’s been no sign that Shiro is interested in him romantically. That changes when Shiro is asked to write a romance novel, and Ichiyou seizes the opportunity—volunteering to play the role of Shiro’s "boyfriend" in hopes of catching his attention. A surprise kiss, a rain-soaked stop at a love hotel, and a “first” night that sends Ichiyou’s heart racing... As the unexpected sweetness of their new dynamic unfolds, Shiro finds himself captivated by Ichiyou’s open and sincere feelings. Will their relationship finally move beyond friendship, or will Ichiyou be left longing for more?

(Source: Overlap, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183937.description:
Haruto is devastated when he discovers his ex-boyfriend is secretly married. Drowning his sorrows at a bar, he meets a man nursing his own heartbreak. They hit it off, and before Haruto knows it, they’re sharing a bed, even though he doesn't even know the man's name. The next morning, Haruto slips away, believing it was just a one-night stand. However, his world is turned upside down when the same man, Hayama Shiori, shows up as his new coworker at his company!

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183938.description:
Kaga Yuudai, a university student studying cosmetology, is on the hunt for a substitute model for an upcoming arts festival show. That's when he encounters Tooji Tooru, a stunning individual whose beauty captivates him, despite Tooru’s reluctance to participate due to his anxiety about public appearances. As Kaga persistently pushes for Tooru to join him, he accidentally confesses his feelings, jokingly suggesting a relationship instead of just modeling. To his surprise, Tooru agrees, but with a twist: their relationship will be a “trial” until the arts festival concludes. Kaga, typically popular with women but struggling with past rejections from men, finds himself in a complex situation. As they prepare for the festival, Tooru’s unexpected intensity and genuine feelings for Kaga begin to surface, leading to an intimate exploration of their relationship.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ふれてキスして恋着させて

183939.description:
After graduating from middle school, Aoi is left to fend for himself following his family's split, making a living through insurance scams. One day, while attempting to stage an accident by jumping in front of a luxury car, he’s caught red-handed by the car's owner, Inami. Unfazed by Aoi’s fake signs of pain, Inami surprises him with an unusual proposition: “If you don’t want me to report you, play the role of my lover.” With no other choice, Aoi finds himself moving into Inami’s upscale apartment. From that day forward, his life takes a sharp turn as he’s thrust into a world of sophistication and high society. Inami begins training Aoi in English conversation, table manners, and etiquette, pushing him through a whirlwind of new experiences...?!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title.native: 玉の輿ご用意しました

183940.description:
In a post-apocalyptic world where humanity has mostly vanished, Hazukuro, a humble tailor, is left to mourn the death of Godou—the man he has secretly loved since their school days. As Godou draws his last breath in front of him, Hazukuro's heart shatters. But just as despair sets in, a devilish-looking stranger appears and offers Hazukuro a strange "magic sewing machine" with a chilling promise: to bring Godou back, albeit in an artificial, humanoid form. Using the sewing machine, Hazukuro painstakingly stitches together a new version of Godou—identical in appearance to the real one. To Hazukuro’s amazement, the newly sewn Godou comes to life, moving and speaking as if he were real. But there’s something missing—this Godou lacks the human soul that once made him whole. Despite the physical likeness, Hazukuro knows that the essence of the person he loves is absent. The devilish man, still lurking in the background, reveals that Godou’s soul is out there, somewhere in the world, waiting to be "sewn" back into the body. With little more than a needle, thread, and the mysterious sewing machine, Hazukuro sets out on a perilous journey across the ravaged landscape, seeking the fragments of Godou’s soul. What awaits Hazukuro and Godou at the end of this journey?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

183941.description:
"Hare's Nest" is an elite group of private bodyguards and security contractors. Asato, a highly skilled rabbit beastman admired by his peers, is in a secret relationship with Takara, his boss and the CEO's son. At work, they pretend to hate each other, maintaining a professional facade. But when they're alone...?!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183942.description:
The best guys are where you least expect them.

One lonely night, Julia finds an odd boy named William in her wardrobe. They quickly become friends, and soon he begins appearing whenever she needs someone to talk to. As the two grow closer, Julia falls for this mysterious boy, igniting a magical love story that transcends time and space.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

183943.description:
Yuujin, a high school student, lives with his childhood friend, Chihaya, and Chihaya's younger sister. While Yuujin secretly admires Chihaya for managing to care for his sister while searching for his missing father, he also sees him as a rival. When Yuujin's parents grow frustrated with his lack of focus, they ask Chihaya to be his "chaperone." Acting like a bodyguard only makes Yuujin more irritated. One day, after an older woman confesses to Yuujin, he brags to Chihaya about having his first girlfriend. Chihaya replies, “Let’s practice wearing a condom for when the time comes!” When Yuujin refuses, Chihaya decides to demonstrate... right in front of him!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 恋邪魔な幼なじみがムカつく

183944.description:
College student Kuramochi Rintarou, born and raised as the son of a ryokan (Japanese inn), has always been a good listener and was brought up with tender care. As a result, he finds it hard to say no to requests and often takes on part-time jobs for his friends. One day, he ends up working at a cross-dressing concept café. While touting for customers, he gets caught up with a drunk, only to be rescued by a group of men who look like yakuza. To his surprise, the man leading the group is none other than Shirasawa-senpai, a popular senior at his university who girls always surround.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 秘密ありきの僕たちですが
title.romaji: Himitsu Ariki no Bokutachi desu ga

183945.description:
Shindou Shuuichi, a serious and dependable man who appears outgoing and positive, is secretly quite fragile and lonely. After being dumped by his girlfriend for seeking affection, Shindou struggles with stress and insomnia due to work. One night, he stumbles upon a stream titled “Good Night Stream," hosted by a soothing streamer named K. The kind words and comforting voice of K help Shindou relax and fall asleep, and soon, he becomes addicted to K’s streams, finding comfort in the pampering he craves. One day, Shindou meets Haruna Kei, a college student who lives in the same apartment building. To his surprise, Haruna’s voice sounds strikingly similar to K’s, and when H\K shares a story Shindou had with Shindou mentioned on stream, everything falls into place. Realizing Haruna might be K, Shindou resolves not to interfere with K's streaming identity or reveal himself as a listener. However, despite his intentions, Shindou and Haruna’s relationship starts to grow closer, complicating things further...

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

title.native: 溺愛スリーピングボイス

183946.description:
Taichi, a college student, stumbles upon an old shrine on his way home from his part-time job. Without giving it much thought, he casually prays for two things: a fluffy pet and a lover. Later that night, when Taichi returns home, he is shocked to find a strange man waiting for him—complete with fox ears and a tail. The man introduces himself as Kon, claiming to have come to fulfill Taichi's wishes. Exhausted from his day, Taichi brushes off the bizarre encounter and tries to sleep, ignoring Kon’s presence. However, Kon, clearly displeased by being dismissed, sneaks into Taichi's bed, determined to stay close to him...

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

183947.description:
Hisaki, who has always prided himself on treating everyone equally, finds himself in a bind when Munenori, a straight man he just met, suddenly insists on becoming his servant. Though Hisaki values rationality and self-control, Munenori’s insistence stirs something within him, making it hard to keep his composure. Now, Hisaki must navigate the tension between his deeply held beliefs and the unexpected desires Munenori awakens in him...

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Note: includes one extra chapter.

183948.description:
Straight man Seno Atsushi finds himself in an unexpected situation when he’s embraced by an older gay man, Hidaka. It all started one night when a friend dragged him to a gay bar. Drunk and careless, Atsushi made a disparaging comment about gay men, which led to a bold punishment from Hidaka—a kiss that spiraled into an unexpected arrangement. What began as a casual "friends with benefits" deal meant to last until Hidaka got bored slowly started to change. Atsushi finds himself drawn to Hidaka, whose teasing nature is balanced by surprising moments of tenderness. Despite their unconventional start, Atsushi can’t help but fall in love.

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183949.description:
Naruse Shouta, a struggling theater troupe member, encounters a mysterious father and son under the light of a full moon. The father, Hase Naoki, a university lecturer, shares a startling secret about his son, Yuzuki...?!

(Source: Koubunsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

"I'm so happy that we are together."
Haru and Kenichi's relationship has been going smoothly, filled with love and happiness. However, their bliss is interrupted when Haru's overprotective older brother unexpectedly shows up!

(Source: Kasakura Publishing, translated)

183951.description:
Eito, nicknamed “Hawkeye,” is an elite secret police officer known for his flawless execution of every mission. However, beneath his professional demeanor, he is a new father struggling with the fact that his young son, Tsubasa, doesn't seem to miss him when he comes home. Despite this, Eito cherishes his life with his loving wife, Yui, and their son. Just as he's beginning to balance his high-stakes career with family life, he learns that someone is targeting not only him but also his beloved family...

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183952.description:
Ousei Minami is a police officer who hides the fact that he is an omega, but one day, a yakuza member, Jin Nagiri, finds out about it. What's more, he even barges into his house and tells him, "You're my destined partner." As soon as he says that, Minami who isn't supposed to be in heat, starts to feel the heat...! Contrary to his feelings of not wanting to be fucked by a yakuza, he's dripping wet down there. "Just pray that you won't get pregnant." Nagiri is excited by Ousei's pheromones. He rubs against him over and over again and cums inside him...!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183955.description:
A darkly comic look at the meaning and meaninglessness of life, through the eyes of various adorable and occasionally psychopathic species facing extinction.

A humble rock is at the center of this transmigratory tale of two souls who take the form of penguins, otters, crows, and more as they learn about the the value of culture, the beauty of play in the face of capitalist pressure to produce and reproduce, and the power of love in the face of total annihilation.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

No matter how carefully we obey or how strongly we resist, there is only despair… The setting is the “War Prison," filled with who resist reincarnation, and those who are tossed about by the waves of fate… Those who possess god-like powers must fight against each other, scattered throughout time and space....

183969.description:
"Hinomoto" is a place where ronin and monsters roam. At the age of 10, Kirimaru's parents were brutally murdered and his house burned down by a man wearing a demon mask and wielding an evil sword. Kirimaru vows to take revenge and sets out to find his enemy. His journey to catch the masked man is also a journey to find the sword itself. A dark fantasy epic of destiny and revenge; the samurai battle action begins!

(Source: Comipo Comics, translated)

183971.description:
Disgraced and executed for a crime she did not commit, Lady Letizia Manere is reborn to a time before everything went wrong in her life. Determined to make sure she doesn’t suffer the same fate, Letizia rebels against her family and the confines of high society. When the mysterious man who showed her kindness in her past life is in danger, she intervenes and becomes embroiled in a plot she could have never imagined. Can Letizia save herself and those she loves when given a second chance at life?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: It's Time to Look for a New Family

title.english: I'll Just Look for a New Family

183972.description:
An actress who is transported to another world and becomes a saint, she is given the nickname “the lady who moved dimensions,” but she does not receive any special attention. All the attention is on Princess Ronella Nestro, who is the emperor's bride and the heroine of the prophecy.

Emilone discovers that the princess is a fake who pretends to be innocent and kind, but is actually a cruel and ambitious manipulator. Emilone decides to get closer to the princess out of fun and curiosity, but ends up getting involved in a web of intrigues, secrets and temptations.

She also attracts the attention of the emperor, who is a mysterious and powerful man who hides his feelings. Emilone will have to use her intelligence and charm to survive and find her place in this new world.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

183973.description:
Despite his plain appearance and reclusive lifestyle, Hajime secretly posts suggestive photos of himself on social media using an alternate account. Recently, an older man he’s gotten close to online asks to meet up, so Hajime steps outside for the first time in years and waits. But when his contact arrives, it turns out to be Ayumu—the ultra-handsome idol…

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183974.description:
Hidaka has never felt sexual desire toward anyone—until he experiences his first stirrings of attraction toward Mizuki, a sex worker who frequently uses the love hotel where Hidaka works part-time. Confused by these unexpected feelings, Hidaka finds that he still feels the same pull the next time they meet. But more than that, he begins to want to know more about Mizuki himself…

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: includes one extra chapter.

183976.description:
Morimoto, a high school student with a complex and extreme fetish, finds himself in a state of ecstasy on the edge between life and death. Due to his troubling habit of needing to feel close to death for satisfaction, he secretly engages in self-pleasure each day with a thick rope around his neck. One day, a man suddenly jumps into Morimoto's room through the window! With wings on his back, the man introduces himself as Tanaka and claims he is an “angel”...

(Source: Kasakura, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

183977.description:
"I want you to take control of my heart and body—all of me…"

This anthology delves into the world of love and submission between Doms, with the instinct to dominate, and Subs, with the desire to be controlled. Featuring all-new stories from an impressive lineup of popular mangaka, including Nonono Yamada, Aya Sakyo, and Scarlet Beriko!

183978.description:
Natsuhara Minato, a high school student aspiring to become a BL manga artist, finds himself stuck in writer's block right before his debut. One day, while increasingly anxious, he accidentally drops his story idea notebook, and it’s picked up by Yukino Ryousuke, the most popular guy in their grade. Bracing himself to be mocked for drawing BL, Minato is surprised when Yukino reacts positively and, unexpectedly, offers a suggestion to help Minato, who has no romantic experience...

(Source: Live Comics, translated)

183979.description:
Sophia, the first princess of the Kingdom of Eugenis, suddenly remembers her past life as a witch. It’s a memory from 200 years ago, when she protected her country in solitude, ending with a wish to "live a happy life with someone in the next life." Yet here she is, seemingly malnourished and covered in bruises, referred to by the castle servers as the "unlucky princess." She decides that if things don’t improve after appealing to her grandfather, the king, she’ll leave the palace and make her own way.

"Wait... Am I actually more loved than I realized?"

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

183980.description:
Rikuto, an introverted university student who just wants a peaceful life, spends each day quietly, trying not to stand out. However, by some twist of fate, he catches the interest of Amir—a dazzling, prince-like foreign exchange student—and ends up attending a drinking party full of outgoing people. In this unfamiliar setting, Rikuto drinks too much and finds himself “taken care of” by Amir, leading to a surprisingly pleasant experience. The next morning, Amir drops an unexpected revelation: “I’m a prince from a magical kingdom.”

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

183981.description:
"Want me to help you with your xxxxx?"

There's no need for romance between guys... Though that's what he wants to believe, Kagami Yui, an out-of-place troublemaker of the grade, always felt like he lacked something. One afternoon, when he was getting 'toyed' with by his seniors as usual, he is caught by Kiyomitsu Okuda, a nosy member of the disciplinary committee. Out of frustration and horniness, Yui tries to mess with Okuda by showing off his used condoms, and teases his clean and goody-two-shoes personality. However, things take an unexpected turn when Okuda responds with an intense nose bleed and a huge boner... A secretly member of the perverted disciplinary committee × lonely troublemaker They're lewd, mean, but also pure...? A stormy, horny and sweet school love begins!

(Source: .ink works)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 加賀美くんは寂しがりやな甘えんぼ

183982.description:
In modern-day Korea, the Imperial Family holds a secret duty of exorcizing "Imae,'' creatures that lurk within paintings to feed on the grief of humans. But such beings can only be detected by people like Jo Yu-Yeon who possess the Sacred Eye. Despite knowing that Crown Prince Geon needs her special vision, Yu-Yeon gets caught up in a deceptive marriage plan to make it seem like another woman has her ability instead. But no secret can be kept forever. What will become of Yu-Yeon once it's revealed that she is the keeper Geon has always been looking for?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

183995.description:
"No matter how many times we're reborn, I'm sure we'll fall in love again. Because Kotaro and I are bound by the red string of fate." Kaede is a housewife, romanticist, and lover of peace, always one to avoid conflict. In fact, she and her husband Kotaro are so blissfully married that they've never even gotten into an argument. On the evening of her fifth wedding anniversary, as she heads towards the restaurant, she reflects on how much she appreciates her kind husband and the perfect marriage he's given her. But when a figure rushes in and attacks her from behind, her life begins to fall into disarray...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Chapter count includes three volume-bonus chapters.

183996.description:
Renji Himuro is a man who has risen from a delinquent on the streets of Yokohama to become the young leader of Japan's largest criminal organization, the Kyowakai, with his sights set on unifying the entire Japanese underworld. One day, he receives an anonymous message. The message reads, “We are waiting for you, come alone," along with a picture of his only son all tied up. The lonely struggle of Japan's most powerful gangster begins…

(Source: Young Champions Web, translated)
